title: Lingam
summary:
Lingam is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language crime drama television series created by Prasanth Pandiyaraj for JioHotstar. The series is inspired by the life of V. Lingam, a notorious gangster from Kanyakumari district from 1987 to 1995.The series is written and directed by Lakshmi Saravanakumar and produced by Raadhika Srinivasan and B. Srinivasan under the banner of Vikatan Televistas.
It follows the dark transformation of a talented Kabaddi champion who is falsely accused of murder on the brink of his athletic success, forcing him into a violent and dangerous underworld. The series stars Kathir, Divyabharathi, Shahir and Poornima Ravi in lead roles.It was released on JioHotstar for its label Hotstar Specials on 26 June 2026 and declared a Streaming Blockbuster.
plot: Muthulingam "Lingam", a brilliant kabaddi champion whose ambition of joining the police force is crushed by a tragic, unjust incident. Wrongfully accused, he is cast into a ruthless criminal underworld. Driven by intense grief and vengeance following the murder of his mentor, Chellapandian, Lingam targets the powerful antagonist, Samiyappan. His path takes a dangerous turn when he attempts to protect a young couple, thrusting him into a massive crisis that forces him into hiding.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Lingam was written and directed by Lakshmi Saravanakumar, who based the series on the life of V. Lingam, a notorious gangster from Kanyakumari district, while fictionalising several incidents for dramatic purposes. Filmmaker Prasanth Pandiyaraj, known for Vilangu, joined the project as its presenter.The series was produced by Vikatan Televistas for Hotstar Specials and was officially announced as part of the platform's slate of 25 Tamil original productions in December 2025.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: In December 2025, Kathir was announced to portray the titular character, Lingam. Divyabharathi was cast as the female lead, while Shahir, Poornima Ravi, Bose Venkat, Nikhila Sankar, and Vimal joined the supporting cast.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first trailer of Lingam was released on 6 June 2026, showcasing the transformation of an aspiring police officer and kabaddi player into a feared gangster after being falsely accused of murder.The series premiered on JioHotstar on 26 June 2026 in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Hindi, Marathi and Bengali.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text:
Sree of OTT Release gave 4/5 stars and wrote that, "Overall Lingam is a crime drama with good performances, a well-paced story and plenty of suspense. If you are looking for a Tamil series that’s exciting and has a lot of action, emotion and mystery you should watch *Lingam*.Siddartha Toleti of M9 News wrote that, "Long gone are the days when OTTs were a breath of fresh air and served as a medium for alternative storytelling. With digital viewership more or less reaching the saturation point across many platforms, it is not surprising that the idea is to consolidate rather than push the bar. Lingam is just a byproduct of that, needlessly reviving a brand of cinema that has already fallen out of favour with audiences in recent years. Even if rural gangster dramas are your forte, find a better way to kill time than watching Lingam".
Jeevaganesh. P of Ananda Vikatan wrote that, "Even though it changes direction in the second half, 'Lingam' is definitely worth watching as it is a good start and thriller for a gangster movie".

episodesList.title: First Wave of the Ocean
episodesList.summary: Lingam's long-awaited police appointment is delayed, pushing him into a high-stakes tournament. But when a fierce match turns violent, a shocking murder changes everything.

episodesList.title: Shadow of the Cry
episodesList.summary: The police finally track down Lingam. Inside the prison, he endures brutal torture, humiliation and violence that slowly harden him into a ruthless and emotionally scarred man.

episodesList.title: The Fury of Fate
episodesList.summary: The cops harass Lingam by making him the go-to suspect for any crime. Chelladurai also underhandedly uses him as a henchman. Pushed to his limits, Lingam's anger boils over.

episodesList.title: The Sea Rises
episodesList.summary: Lingam joins Chellapandian's illicit liquor network and plays a major role in expanding his business. After saving his boss from a deadly attack, Lingam earns his trust.

episodesList.title: The Season of Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Lingam marries Ponmalar, hoping to finally build a peaceful life. But a conspiracy unfolds involving poisoned liquor. Enraged, Lingam begins hunting down those responsible.

episodesList.title: The Chill of a Mild Tremor
episodesList.summary: Driven by revenge for Chellapandian's death, Lingam hunts down Samiyappan. While helping a young couple, he finds himself in a crisis and is compelled to go into hiding.

episodesList.title: The Breaking Palm Tree
episodesList.summary: Lingam rises as the undisputed kingpin of Kanyakumari. As his friendship with Thiru deteriorates, Lingam discovers the puppeteer pulling Chellapandian and Samiyappan's strings.

episodesList.title: The Burning Sea
episodesList.summary: Devastated by Bhaskar's death, Lingam swears revenge against Chelladurai, adding to his mother's misery. Lingam gives Chelladurai 30 days to prepare for the consequences.

soundtrack.title: Track listing
soundtrack.composer: The series has music and background score composed by Tony Britto, in his maiden collaboration with Kathir and Lakshmi Saravanakumar. The audio rights were acquired by Star India Pvt. Ltd.

title: Local Times
summary:
Local Times is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language workplace comedy-drama streaming television series created by Abbhinav Kastura and Praveen Muthurangan for Amazon Prime Video. Directed by Naveen George Thomas in his directorial debut, the series stars Rishikanth, Abdool Lee, Adwitha Arumugam, Maurish Dass, R. Pandiarajan, and Chinni Jayanth.
The series centers on a struggling local newspaper and follows four friends managing the publication.
plot:
The story revolves around Namma Seidhi, a once-respected regional weekly newspaper founded by the grandfather of Veera. In a landscape dominated by instant digital media and social media trends, the publication is on the verge of financial collapse, surviving primarily on the hope and grit of its small team.
Veera, driven by a sense of legacy, works alongside his best friend Azhagu, the resourceful Valli, and a dedicated intern, Muthu. Rather than hard-hitting investigative journalism, the team's daily routine often involves the more mundane struggles of news-gathering, securing local advertisements, managing mounting debts, and navigating petty office politics.
reception:
The series received generally positive reviews, with critics describing it as a light-hearted and feel-good watch. The Times of India noted that while the script relied on "contrived writing," the performances and "core friendship" made it an engaging "time-pass" watch.
Writing for The Hollywood Reporter India, Vishal Menon characterized the show as "basic background viewing pleasure," citing the relatable setting and likeable characters.
Scroll.in found the show's focus was on character-driven humor rather than the mechanics of journalism, remarking that "low on news-gathering and high on joke-gathering."
Cinema Express gave a negative review in which M Narayani stated ..."the screenplay starts to shred apart due to the lack of a novel premise. The comedy sequences too offer no respite from the drab scenes, and every time a character tries to break into a joke or two, the results lie somewhere in between eye-roll-inducing and something as old as the 2000s"

episodesList.title: Avargal
episodesList.summary: A proof-of-life photo from a local kidnapping features their newspaper, pulling the gang into the case. Covertly helping the police to crack it- in the process, they accidentally land their first big headline.

episodesList.title: Indru Poi Naalai Vaa
episodesList.summary: A payment blunder bruises the ego of a local boxer, prompting a one-on-one challenge. Just as the gang scrambles for a champion amongst themselves, the kidnapper from previous episode returns, setting the stage for a chaotic showdown as multiple gangs converge on their office, all focused to destroy them.

episodesList.title: Aan Paavam
episodesList.summary: A 40-year-old woman shocks the gang by requesting an ad in their newspaper putting herself up for adoption after being abandoned by her children. A new interested party pressures them to sell their newspaper, sparking a rift between Veera and Azhagu.

episodesList.title: Iruvar
episodesList.summary: After an intense fight, Azhagu quits Namma Seidhi, leaving the gang in shock. While dealing with the fallout, a vlogger drags the newspaper into an expose, accusing it of promoting low-quality restaurants and calling it a scam. Will Veera and Azhagu bury the hatchet to save the paper, or is this the end of Namma Seidhi?

episodesList.title: Nizhal Nijamaagiradhu
episodesList.summary: An anonymous source approaches the gang with news before it happens. Initially wary, they decide to publish his stories, and after missing the first-which proves true-the second one boosts their PR. As trust in the source grows, could this partnership save their sinking newspaper, or his good deeds too good to be true?

episodesList.title: Naalaya Seidhi
episodesList.summary: After a major story from the new source backfires, nearly driving away all their advertisers, the gang discovers the identity of the puppet master behind the chaos. He has a clear agenda: to buy Namma Seidhi as cheaply as possible by playing as dirty as possible.

episodesList.title: Makkal Aatchi
episodesList.summary: The gang makes the biggest blunder in the history of Newsprint -printing empty pages that reach the community. But a stroke of luck turns the mistake into a symbol of protest. Will they survive the fallout, or is this truly the end of Namma Seidhi?

title: Lakshmi Niwas
summary: Lakshmi Niwas is an Indian Hindi-language  family drama television series which premiered on 12 January 2026 on Zee TV. Produced by Rashmi Sharma Telefilms, the series is a remake of the Kannada drama Lakshmi Nivasa from Zee Kannada. It stars Manasi Joshi Roy, and Rajendra Chawla.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Manasi Joshi Roy as Lakshmi Jaiswal: Shrinivas's wife (2026–present) * Rajendra Chawla as Srinivas Jaiswal: Lakshmi's husband (2026–present) * Akshita Mudgal as Radhika Chauhan (née Jaiswal): Lakshmi and Shrinivas's middle daughter; Veer's wife (2026–present) * Raghav Tiwari as Veer Chauhan: Gajendra and Nalini's son; Radhika's husband (2026–present) * Riya Munjal as Bhoomika Bundela (née Jaiswal): Lakshmi and Shrinivas's youngest daughter (2026–present) * Priom Gujjar as Raj Bundela: Bhoomika's husband (2026–present)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Manasi Joshi Roy and Rajendra Chawla confirmed to play Lakshmi and Srinivas. Akshita Mudgal was selected to play Radhika. Gashmeer Mahajani was chosen to play Aditya.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas’s Dream and Lakshmi’s Concern
episodesList.summary: As retirement nears, Shriniwas dreams of building a home to honour his wife Lakshmi’s long-held vow. Meanwhile, Lakshmi is weighed down by the responsibility of daughters’ impending marriages.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi is Saddened As Radhika’s Alliance Fails
episodesList.summary: The morning after Lakshmi’s birthday brings gloom, yet Shriniwas consoles her over Radhika’s broken alliance. Meanwhile, Aditya’s mother finds a life partner for him!

episodesList.title: A Marriage Proposal For Radhika
episodesList.summary: Veer, Gajendra’s younger son, makes cunning moves to secure his father’s election victory. Meanwhile, Aditya’s mother Vandana brings a proposal for Radhika to Lakshmi, leaving her lost in thought.

episodesList.title: Will Radhika Agree to Marry Aditya?
episodesList.summary: An argument breaks out over Aditya’s marriage proposal for Radhika, who then announces her decision. Some goons attack Veer at the temple, and Lakshmi gets worried after witnessing a bad omen.

episodesList.title: Aditya and Radhika’s Alliance is Fixed
episodesList.summary: Aditya’s family visits Lakshmi, who then informs them about the flaw in Radhika’s horoscope. Vandana finalises Aditya and Radhika’s alliance, but Aditya’s sister Isha is unhappy with the match.

episodesList.title: Isha’s Demand to Lakshmi Over The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Isha arrives at Lakshmi’s home and pressures her to ensure the wedding is perfect. Lakshmi discusses the expenses with Sriniwas, who conceals his contribution to his friend Shankar’s treatment.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Grows Anxious Over Finances
episodesList.summary: At office, Aditya announces his marriage to Radhika. Meanwhile, a pundit suggests an auspicious date just four days away. After Shankar’s death, Shriniwas grows anxious about arranging the money.

episodesList.title: Aditya and Radhika Spend Time Together
episodesList.summary: Vivek and Varun dodge wedding expenses with excuses, while Manish offers Lakshmi support, but Meenakshi intervenes. Aditya and Radhika treasure moments together before their marriage.

episodesList.title: Radhika Worries For Lakshmi and Shriniwas
episodesList.summary: Raju spots Vivek and Varun smoking together. Radhika grows uneasy as she sees Lakshmi and Shriniwas worried about the wedding. Later, Isha calls Lakshmi, and her words intensify Lakshmi’s worry.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi Meets Veer At The Temple
episodesList.summary: Gajendra entrusts Veer with Alok’s work. At the temple, Lakshmi recalls a vow after encountering her brother and sister-in-law. Suddenly, she falls ill, and Veer miraculously steps in to support her.

episodesList.title: Sriniwas Takes a Loan For Radhika’s Wedding
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi gives her jewellery to Sriniwas to sell and asks the family to prepare for the wedding. Elsewhere, Adhitya buys a ring for Radhika. Later, Sriniwas mortgages the land papers to take a loan.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi and Shriniwas Visit Gajendra’s House
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika tells Radhika her idea of a prince charming. Lakshmi buys sarees for her daughters-in-law, while Raju lovingly purchases one for her. Later, Lakshmi and Shriniwas visit Gajendra’s house.

episodesList.title: Gajendra Insults Shriniwas and Lakshmi
episodesList.summary: Gajendra and his mother insult Shriniwas and Lakshmi when they come with Radhika's wedding card. At the office, Shriniwas faces a shocking revelation, while Varun fumes seeing Bhoomika with Kunal.

episodesList.title: Aditya Heads Off to His Wedding!
episodesList.summary: Radhika gets ready for her wedding as Aditya drives off with Vandana. Meanwhile, Isha frets over being unable to stop their marriage, and Akhil waits for his dangerous plan to unfold!

episodesList.title: Radhika is Blamed For Aditya’s Accident
episodesList.summary: On the way to the wedding, a truck crashes into Aditya’s car, which then collides with Veer’s. Akhil rejoices at his ploy’s success, but Veer blames himself, and at the hospital, Radhika is blamed.

episodesList.title: Aditya and Vandana Breathe Their Last
episodesList.summary: At Gajendra’s order, Kishor bribes a doctor to mislead Veer that Aditya’s family is safe. Soon, Radhika and her family are shattered to learn Aditya and Vandana are dead, as Akhil and Isha blame her.

episodesList.title: Radhika Stands Tall For Niya
episodesList.summary: The doctor reveals how a man saved Niya, yet she cannot walk. Radhika defends her against Isha and brings her home, while Akhil accepts money from Kishor, letting him believe Veer caused the accident.

episodesList.title: Niya’s Longing and Akhil’s Shocking Act
episodesList.summary: Radhika’s family consoles Niya as she longs for Aditya and Vandana. Akhil’s shocking revelation of performing their last rites alone stuns Lakshmi and Shriniwas, while Isha vows revenge on Radhika.

episodesList.title: Radhika’s Decision Stirs Chaos
episodesList.summary: Veer confides in Nandini after the tragic incident. Radhika’s decision to keep Niya in the house stirs chaos. Later, Shriniwas supports Radhika.

episodesList.title: A News Item Troubles Gajendra
episodesList.summary: Veer comes face-to-face with Radhika during a brawl and thanks the goddess for catching a glimpse of her. Kunal insists Bhoomika to attend the college fest. A scandalous news item troubles Gajendra.

episodesList.title: Gajendra Plans to Meet Lakshmi and Shriniwas
episodesList.summary: Gajendra, worried for Veer after hearing of Aditya’s accident from Aishwarya, decides to visit Lakshmi and Shriniwas. Meanwhile, Veer again encounters Radhika while helping college students.

episodesList.title: Gajendra Visits Shriniwas' House For Answers
episodesList.summary: Veer is amazed to meet Radhika again. She inspires Bhoomika to join the fest, while Vijendra wishes Kunal luck. With Nalini, Gajendra visits Shriniwas, quietly seeking details of Aditya’s accident.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika’s Unexpected Meeting With Raj Bundela
episodesList.summary: Gajendra is relieved that Radhika’s family knows little about Aditya’s accident. Meanwhile, Bhoomika meets dynamic industrialist Raj Bundela while preparing her welcome speech for the college fest.

episodesList.title: A Call From Isha’s Lawyer Sparks Panic
episodesList.summary: Akhil’s mother moves into Isha’s home, but a call from her lawyer sparks panic. Raj shocks Bhoomika’s family by entering her house with his men, while Kunal is busy with his friends at college.

episodesList.title: Aditya’s will Worries Isha and Akhil
episodesList.summary: Raj shocks Bhoomika’s family by proposing marriage on his first visit. Aditya’s first will stuns Akhil and his mother, while Isha doubts Niya can return. Radhika fears Veer, but he is drawn to her.

episodesList.title: Radhika Cornered By The Police
episodesList.summary: At college, Bhoomika shocks Kunal by revealing Raj’s marriage proposal. As police summon Radhika and Niya, Lakshmi and Shriniwas are arrested, leaving Radhika trapped by a cruel ultimatum.

episodesList.title: Akhil’s Mother Snatches Niya From Radhika
episodesList.summary: Shockingly, an inspector lets Akhil’s mother snatch Niya from Radhika and leave with him and Isha, and later forces Radhika to sign a paper. At night, Lakshmi and Shriniwas wonder who bailed them out.

episodesList.title: Veer Trails Radhika to Lakshmi’s House
episodesList.summary: Isha stays unaware as Akhil and his mother torture Niya to keep her fearful and obedient. Veer follows Radhika to her locality, where Lakshmi welcomes him home, and he ends up saving Janaki’s life.

episodesList.title: Akhil and His Mother Harass Niya
episodesList.summary: Akhil and his mother sack the household staff and harass Niya by forcing her into chores. Meanwhile, Veer follows Radhika to her office, trying desperately to talk to her.

episodesList.title: Akhil and Isha Fire Radhika From The Job
episodesList.summary: At the office, Radhika misses Niya and Aditya, but Akhil and Isha fire her. Later, the moneylender warns Shriniwas he’ll seize his land if the loan isn’t repaid and a worried Shriniwas returns home.

episodesList.title: Mr Beniwal’s Unexpected Move
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas reveals the danger to his land, while Akhil celebrates. The next day, a stunning twist unfolds as Mr Beniwal returns the land, and Lakshmi and Shriniwas leave for Raj Bundela’s office.

episodesList.title: Raj’s Proposal and Kunal’s Confession
episodesList.summary: Raj’s secret help comes to light as Lakshmi and Shriniwas consider his proposal for Bhoomika. Kunal is unsure if Bhoomika heard his confession. Veer asks Radhika’s name, but she misunderstands him.

episodesList.title: Niya Sends Radhika a Message
episodesList.summary: As Bhoomika’s family considers Raj’s proposal, Kunal’s friends stop him from a fight and urge him to win her trust. At night, Radhika hears Niya’s message, but is insulted on visiting her with laddus.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Bold Move to Meet Niya
episodesList.summary: With favourable feedback on Raj, the family plans to move ahead with the proposal, but Bhoomika faces uncertainty. The next day, Radhika sneaks into Isha and Akhil’s party as a waitress to meet Niya.

episodesList.title: Radhika Saves Niya From Harm
episodesList.summary: At Isha’s party, Radhika is pained to see Akhil and his mother mistreat Niya. She rescues her, but Isha blocks the way. Meanwhile, Veer avoids a proposed match as his heart still longs for Radhika.

episodesList.title: Kunal is Hurt As Bhoomika Chooses Raj
episodesList.summary: Kunal’s confession goes awry when Bhoomika misreads his intentions, and her family begins to support Raj’s proposal. Meanwhile, Veer receives unexpected news that heightens the growing tension.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika’s New Beginning and Kunal’s Dark Night
episodesList.summary: As Bhoomika’s family prepares for her engagement with Raj, Kunal quietly fights his heartbreak. Meanwhile, Lakshmi suggests an idea to support Radhika, who is deeply troubled by Niya’s distress.

episodesList.title: Kunal Finds a Reason to Forget Bhoomika
episodesList.summary: Raj and Bhoomika get engaged as Kunal’s aunt urges him to forget Bhoomika, citing Lakshmi’s past. The next day, Raj visits Bhoomika for her birthday, while Siddhu meets Veer to help impress Radhika.

episodesList.title: Veer Sees Radhika Outside Aditya’s Bungalow
episodesList.summary: Raj takes Bhoomika out on her birthday, while Kunal realises how strongly his family fears love. Siddhu guides Veer on winning Radhika over, but Veer is stunned to see her outside Aditya’s bungalow.

episodesList.title: Radhika’s Secret Entry With Veer
episodesList.summary: With Veer’s support, Radhika sneaks into Aditya’s house to meet Niya but Akhil’s mother turns her away. Kunal’s friends visit him, while Raj takes Bhoomika on a chartered flight on her birthday.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Sadness Unsettles Veer
episodesList.summary: Veer sees Radhika leaving Aditya’s bungalow and decides to know the reason behind her sadness. Bhoomika celebrates her birthday abroad with Raj, while Shriniwas learns from Lakshmi about Raj’s visit.

episodesList.title: Veer's Trick to Make Radhika Smile
episodesList.summary: Veer uses a trick to make Radhika smile. Raj drops Bhoomika home and exchanges numbers with her. Meanwhile, Kunal’s friends urge him to stop her wedding, but his aunt tells them to let him move on.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika Feels Close to Raj
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika grows emotionally close to Raj, unaware that Kunal is sinking into heartbreak. Veer worries about cheering Radhika up as she fears for Niya, who faces cruelty from Akhil and his mother.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika and Raj’s Wedding Shopping Trip
episodesList.summary: Akhil’s mother locks Niya in a room as punishment, while Isha searches for her. Meanwhile, at Raj’s urging, Bhoomika’s family goes wedding shopping at a mall, where Veer spots Radhika and follows her.

episodesList.title: Isha Is Angered by Akhil’s Comments
episodesList.summary: Veer feels glad as Radhika thanks him for rescuing her from the lift. While shopping, Bhoomika tells Raj about Niya. Later, Isha saves Niya from the attic and is upset by Akhil’s remarks about Aditya.

episodesList.title: Niya Flees Home on Holi to Reach Radhika
episodesList.summary: Kunal attempts suicide after learning Bhoomika is falling for Raj as Devika overhears Veer’s plan to celebrate Holi with Radhika. As the Jaiswals celebrate, Niya flees home to reach Radhika.

episodesList.title: Niya Runs Into Veer
episodesList.summary: Niya runs into Veer, who helps her call Radhika and feeds her. Akhil and Isha halt the Jaiswals’ celebration when Niya goes missing. Veer’s friends tease him, until something unexpected happens.

episodesList.title: A Startling Revelation About Aditya's Will
episodesList.summary: Radhika thanks Veer on a call for saving Niya and he introduces himself as Mr. Chauhan. Meanwhile, the lawyer’s revelation about Aditya’s will pushes Isha and Akhil to invite her against their wishes.

episodesList.title: Veer’s Hidden Gift for Radhika
episodesList.summary: Isha calls Radhika at night, but Lakshmi says they will meet her in person. Devika grows wary when Veer carries a gajra, and before Raj and Bhoomika’s yagya, he quietly tucks it into Radhika’s hair.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi's Demand Shocks Everyone
episodesList.summary: Devika asks Veer for the name of the woman he loves, and then the family gathers to pick a match for him. Later, Lakshmi visits Isha’s home and makes a demand for Radhika that leaves everyone stunned.

episodesList.title: Veer Crosses Paths With Radhika Again
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi’s family is amazed by her talent, while Akhil secretly reaches out to Gajendra. Veer dodges Gajendra’s push to choose a match and runs into Radhika, as Raj takes Bhoomika to a surprise spot.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas' Family Visits Gajendra With a Request
episodesList.summary: Devika feels uneasy when Gajendra agrees to attend Bhoomika and Raj's wedding at Shriniwas' request. Later, the Jaiswals welcome Revati's mother Sarla, and Raj joins them for a warm family dinner.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika's Haldi Brings Pain for Kunal
episodesList.summary: The Jaiswals gather for Raj and Bhoomika's Haldi, while Kunal hides his grief as Vijendra asks him to prepare to visit the registrar's office. Meanwhile, Veer's plan fails when Akhil spots his men.

episodesList.title: Radhika Invites Veer to Bhoomika's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Despite Devika calling her jinxed, Bhoomika and Raj include Radhika in the Haldi. Veer keeps calling Radhika, unaware she’s the one he seeks. Later, urged by Niya, she invites him to the wedding.

episodesList.title: Veer Meets Radhika at Bhoomika's Wedding
episodesList.summary: The Jaiswals warmly welcome the Chauhans for the wedding. Meanwhile, Veer’s chance meeting with Lakshmi leads him to the ceremony, but Radhika’s snap judgment could change everything!

episodesList.title: Veer Caught Between Revelations
episodesList.summary: Veer is stunned when Lakshmi introduces him to Radhika and feels perplexed on learning Aishwarya is her daughter‑in‑law. Meanwhile, Gajendra calls Akhil at the same wedding to hear his business offer.

episodesList.title: Kunal Arrives to Stop Bhoomika's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Kunal races to stop Bhoomika’s wedding, but Supriya intervenes. Veer’s sudden arrival stuns his family as Devika digs for proof, while Gajendra grows tense on hearing about Aditya from Isha and Akhil.

episodesList.title: Veer Assumes Radhika Is Niya’s Mother
episodesList.summary: Veer dreams of marrying Radhika as Bhoomika and Raj wed. Radhika clashes with Isha over Niya’s care. Veer’s hopes fade when he assumes Radhika is Niya’s mother, while Devika plots ahead.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika’s Tearful Vidaai
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika’s vidaai takes place, and Raj solely welcomes her into his palatial house. Radhika reassures Lakshmi and Shriniwas, who are upset at Bhoomika’s departure, while Veer reels from heartbreak.

episodesList.title: Raj's Behaviour Shocks Bhoomika
episodesList.summary: Veer is amazed when Devika reveals that Radhika is not married, while Raj’s behaviour on their wedding night leaves Bhoomika shocked. At the same time, Supriya hides Kunal’s heartbreak from Vijendra.

episodesList.title: Veer Visits Aishwarya's in-Laws to Meet Radhika
episodesList.summary: After meeting Gajendra, Isha runs into Devika and introduces Akhil to her. Veer avoids Akhil and later visits Aishwarya’s in‑laws with handmade sweets to see Radhika, but Niya fails to see him again.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi Nivas - March 14, 2026
episodesList.summary: Born into wealth, Lakshmi chooses love over privilege and leads a life of sacrifice with Shriniwas. Years later, the couple still pursues a home of their own and their daughter’s perfect wedding.

episodesList.title: Veer's Arrival Upsets Radhika
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika's calls anger Raj, who tries to control her with the CCTV. Meanwhile, Kunal harms himself, alarming Virendra. Later, Champa misreads Raju’s help, and Veer's visit home upsets Radhika.

episodesList.title: Raj's Actions Hurt Bhoomika
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika’s family misses her, while Raj’s anger leaves her hurt and in tears before they reconcile. Meanwhile, Radhika struggles with the money for Niya’s treatment and makes a difficult choice.

episodesList.title: Veer Learns a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Raj surprises Bhoomika with a candlelight dinner but later grows restless to see her call someone. Veer secretly helps Radhika get a higher salary and soon learns that Niya is Radhika's daughter.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Bold Advice to Veer
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas scolds Vivek and Varun for mocking Radhika’s new job. Radhika then helps Veer dodge a suitress. Raj’s dinner with Bhoomika turns chaotic due to a goon clash that Kunal unexpectedly sees.

episodesList.title: Veer Lands in Trouble Again
episodesList.summary: Vivek hides his loan application, but Varun and Aishwarya’s arrival scares him. Raj has a few goons killed and lies to Bhoomika. Veer is forced to meet a suitress but later gets scolded by Radhika.

episodesList.title: Raj Stays With Bhoomika at Her Parents' House
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas faces humiliation when he urges Shankar's son to return his money. A jealous Raj stays with Bhoomika at her parents’ home for 'Pagfera', while Veer fakes injuries and visits Radhika.

episodesList.title: Raj Fears His Dark Past With Raju
episodesList.summary: Radhika, guilty over Veer, turns to Bhoomika for advice as Raj’s buried past with Raju returns. His jealousy overrides his fear of exposure, and a desperate chase ends with Raju being struck.

episodesList.title: Veer’s Pursuit and Radhika’s Reluctant Steps
episodesList.summary: Raj hides his jealousy when Raju’s gesture makes Bhoomika emotional. Meanwhile, Veer fakes injury to spend time with Radhika at the hospital, and later Isha and Akhil visit her for a legal issue.

episodesList.title: Veer Stands Strong Against Akhil
episodesList.summary: Radhika signs the papers brought by Akhil and Isha, but Vivek tears them in fear of losing Aditya’s wealth. Veer arrives and threatens Akhil, while Raj secretly plants cameras at home.

episodesList.title: Akhil and Gajendra’s Secret Deal
episodesList.summary: Gajendra offers Akhil a deal to keep a secret, while Shriniwas gets bad news. A police confrontation brings Veer and Radhika closer, and Raj is stunned by Radhika’s message about visiting Bhoomika.

episodesList.title: Raj Tries to Isolate Bhoomika From Her Family
episodesList.summary: Denied entry by Raj’s guard, Radhika and Veer fail to meet Bhoomika. Raj then deceives her family to mask his plot to isolate Bhoomika and pays their electricity bill to burden them with obligation.

episodesList.title: Radhika Strikes Back at Veer’s Lies
episodesList.summary: Raj fumes when Raju’s gift delights Bhoomika, while Vijendra uncovers a hospitalised Kunal’s drinking. Champa saves Raju, Lakshmi hears of Shriniwas’s budget woes, and Radhika slaps Veer for his lies.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Faces an Unlikely Superior
episodesList.summary: Vivek and Varun secure their loans with Raj and Gajendra’s help. Shriniwas finds himself reporting to an unexpected boss. Lakshmi checks in with Supriya, while Veer fails to win Radhika’s forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Harish’s Plot Deepens Veer and Radhika’s Rift
episodesList.summary: Radhika stays angry with Veer despite his apologies, fuelled further by Harish’s ploy. Raj’s jealousy harms Sunny and worries Bhoomika, while Veer searches for Radhika at Varun’s store launch.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Revelation at Varun's Store Launch
episodesList.summary: At Varun’s store launch, Radhika makes a revelation that stuns Veer. Raj arrives upset after seeing something shocking at the college, while Gajendra’s taunt hurts Varun but Aishwarya lifts him.

episodesList.title: Veer Helps Radhika Stand Up to Harish
episodesList.summary: Raj terrorises Bhoomika by forcing her to erase a message carved on a classroom desk. Veer exposes Harish’s harassment of Radhika, and she later apologises to Veer as Lakshmi fears a bad omen.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: Broken by his boss’ harsh scolding, Shriniwas meets with a tragic accident. A stunned Bhoomika rushes him to the hospital, and Lakshmi is shocked on learning about the devastating news.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas’s Recovery Rekindles Hope
episodesList.summary: Veer saves Niya from an abduction, earning praise from the Jaiswals as Shriniwas recovers. Revati later criticises Vivek for being detached, while the family waits for Shriniwas to wake.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Faces Fraud Accusations
episodesList.summary: At the hospital, Raj hurts himself and then leaves with Bhoomika. Radhika confides in Veer but snaps when he calls Niya his daughter. Soon, officials accuse Shriniwas of fraud, worrying Lakshmi.

episodesList.title: Veer and Radhika Sneak Into Shriniwas's Office
episodesList.summary: Upset after Vivek and Varun stay home, Lakshmi remains by Shriniwas's side at hospital with Radhika. With her consent, Veer and Radhika sneak into his office as Raj locks Bhoomika in a room at home.

episodesList.title: Joy Turns to Shock for the Jaiswals
episodesList.summary: Radhika thanks Veer for evidence to save Shriniwas, but celebrations turn grim as the police arrest him after he returns home. Elsewhere, Raj manipulates Bhoomika, while Akhil and Isha visit Gajendra.

episodesList.title: Veer Helps Shriniwas
episodesList.summary: Veer secretly bails out Shriniwas from jail. Feeling grateful, Shriniwas agrees to hide the truth from the family. Elsewhere, Vivek feels worried about being exposed.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Faces an Uncertain Future
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas panics after learning that he will retire in a month. Veer ignores Radhika to lure her back, but her cold response shatters him, while Raj fumes after seeing Bhoomika’s chat with Kunal.

episodesList.title: Raj’s Punishment and a Hidden Match
episodesList.summary: Raj punishes Bhoomika for singing at a party and later questions her friend Mukesh about her college circle. Devika tricks Veer into a temple meet, while an injured Shriniwas faces taunts at work.

episodesList.title: Veer Is Cornered Into a Wedding Decision
episodesList.summary: Raj confines Bhoomika at home while secretly probing her past. Veer is shocked when Nalini’s meeting seals his marriage to Mahi, as Radhika stands up to Meenakshi’s demand for Shriniwas’ money.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika Flees From Her House
episodesList.summary: Mahi and her family visits the Chouhans to discuss her match with Veer. While a frustrated Bhoomika flees through a window, Meenakshi visits her home and later informs the Jaiswals about her escape.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika on the Run
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika flees Raj's home. Kunal narrowly misses her after crossing paths with Raj at a park. Devika hires Radhika as a ruse to bring her closer to Veer, as Bhoomika’s family sets out to find her.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika Covers for Raj’s Secret
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika shields Raj as her family checks on her at his mansion. Vivek scolds Radhika for coming home late, but she shuts him down, as Veer agrees to meet Mahi to confess his love for Radhika.

episodesList.title: Raj’s Hunt Through Bhoomika’s Phone
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas hides his retirement while Raj uses Bhoomika’s phone to reach Kunal after she tries to message him. Unaware of this, Kunal goes to pick up Tanu as Radhika heads to Veer’s house for work.

episodesList.title: A Deadly Case of Mistaken Identity
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi visits Shriniwas’s office, unaware it is his retirement day. Raj kills Vinod, mistaking him for Kunal, and lets Meenakshi flee. Later, Veer and Mahi’s 'roka' is finalised against their wishes.

episodesList.title: Vinod’s Survival Sparks Deadly Fear
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas hides his job loss, while Veer learns of Radhika’s birthday from Niya. Raj returns home after killing Vinod, leaving Bhoomika uneasy. Panic strikes when Vinod is found alive.

episodesList.title: Raj Worries About Being Exposed
episodesList.summary: Veer punishes a careless driver for injuring an elderly woman. At the hospital, Raj and Bhoomika meet Vinod as the police question him, leaving Raj anxious about being exposed.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas and Varun’s Hidden Truths
episodesList.summary: Veer’s family prepares for the pre‑wedding ritual. Meanwhile, Revati and Aishwarya argue over chores. Varun and Shriniwas hide secrets, while Raj is stunned by Bhoomika’s family visit.

episodesList.title: Veer and Mahi's Pre-Wedding Ritual Gets Disrupted
episodesList.summary: Raj’s behaviour with Bhoomika sparks Lakshmi’s doubts. Veer and Mahi’s pre-wedding ritual is disrupted while Radhika’s arrival lifts his spirits. Later, Niya suggests Veer an idea.

episodesList.title: Veer's Picnic Plans and Lakshmi's Rising Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Radhika promises to fulfil Niya’s wish but hesitates when asked about a picnic with Veer. As Radhika struggles at work, Veer steps up, while Raj’s behaviour towards Bhoomika raises Lakshmi's concern.

episodesList.title: Hidden Clues Point Towards Raj
episodesList.summary: Janaki and Lakshmi worry for Bhoomika and begin observing her and Raj closely. Meanwhile, Kunal reviews CCTV footage linking Raj’s car to Vinod’s attack, as Varun plans to steal Vivek’s money.

episodesList.title: Radhika’s Kindness Stuns Veer
episodesList.summary: Raj masks his possessiveness around Bhoomika’s family, only to reveal his dark side later, leaving her scared. Veer is moved by Radhika’s gesture. Later, Vijendra hands Kunal and Tanu a task.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Helps an Auto Driver
episodesList.summary: Varun feels worried about being exposed. Shriniwas seeks help to find a new job and later rushes an ailing auto driver to the hospital, while Bhoomika grows irritated with Raj’s possessive nature.

episodesList.title: A Theft Amidst Birthday Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Varun steals Vivek’s money to repay part of his debt, while Radhika’s birthday fills her day with joy. Elsewhere, Tanu hurts Kunal unknowingly, and Champa fiercely protects Raju from goons.

episodesList.title: Veer's Outing With Radhika and Niya
episodesList.summary: Suresh brings Shriniwas to Gajendra for help, but Lakshmi too arrives there. Veer’s surprise outing with Radhika turns tense when Niya disappears, while Vivek panics as his hidden cash goes missing.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi Nivas - April 26, 2026
episodesList.summary: Born into wealth, Lakshmi chooses love over privilege and leads a life of sacrifice with Shriniwas. Years later, the couple still pursues a home of their own and their daughter’s perfect wedding.

episodesList.title: Vivek’s Suspicion Sparks Chaos and Secrets
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas starts anew as an autorickshaw driver but fears when Kailash spots him. Vivek suspects and attacks Raju, then steals from Meenakshi. Raj’s surprise and Bhoomika’s call please Radhika.

episodesList.title: Vijendra Insults Shriniwas
episodesList.summary: Veer is surprised by Radhika’s gratitude for a perfect day. Shriniwas drops Supriya home in a rickshaw but faces Vijendra’s insults. Lakshmi scolds Varun after catching his cricket betting ticket.

episodesList.title: Akhil Catches Veer With Radhika and Niya
episodesList.summary: Varun apologises to Lakshmi but faces a moneylender’s humiliation. Gajendra and Akhil spot Veer with Radhika and Niya. Vivek’s accusation shocks the family, later hurting Revati with his demand.

episodesList.title: Raj’s Deadly Challenge for Bhoomika
episodesList.summary: Raj forces Bhoomika into a dangerous late-night game. Elsewhere, Vijendra explains to Supriya why he insulted Shriniwas. The next day, Veer learns Radhika’s money for Niya's admission is missing.

episodesList.title: Radhika Shaken by the Engagement Twist
episodesList.summary: Mahi and Veer’s engagement news stuns Radhika, while Vivek stirs trouble. Devika plots to pair Radhika with Veer, as Isha fakes support. Elsewhere, Kunal approaches Raj with a business proposal.

episodesList.title: Veer's Engagement Day Sparks Fresh Tension
episodesList.summary: Everyone gathers for Veer and Mahi’s engagement as Radhika drops Niya on her first day of school. Isha plans to stop Radhika from attending the event. Later, Kunal scolds Tanu over Raj’s office visit.

episodesList.title: Devika Plots to Delay Veer’s Engagement
episodesList.summary: Veer and Mahi are left stunned as their families force an engagement. Devika schemes to delay it until Radhika arrives. As Isha abducts Niya to stop Radhika from attending, Raj steps in to help.

episodesList.title: Veer Is Forced Into a Reluctant Engagement
episodesList.summary: Veer feels unsettled at his engagement to Mahi, his heart still with Radhika. While Devika subtly supports him, Isha plots in secret. Veer injures himself to stop it but is forced to exchange rings.

episodesList.title: Veer’s Grandmother Insults the Jaiswals
episodesList.summary: Veer goes to Mahi to call off the engagement. As his grandmother humiliates the Jaiswals over the missing coin, Revati steps in with the truth. Later, Veer’s next move stuns his family.

tagline: In Lakshmi Niwas, a family's hidden secrets unravel as they navigate love, betrayal, and the quest for true belonging.

title: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket
summary: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language coming-of-age sports drama television series written by Aruna Rakhee, directed by Ganesh Karthikeyan, and starring Vikranth, Niyathi Kadambi, Harish, Daffe Naveen, Gundu Karthik, Sindhu Shyam, Smruthi Mohankumar and Ayaz Khan. The series' story is based on Cricket coach Rangan and his students. The show premiered on JioHotstar on 1 January 2026 and ended with 120 episodes on 23 July 2026.
plot: This series follows a failed cricket player turned coach for the Muthu Nagar Cricket Academy team (Rangan). Rangan's journey along with students at the struggling academy, who unite to preserve a legacy while finding their own paths, forms the main plotline.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
The series was announced by JioHotstar under the banner of South UnBound on 9 December 2025. The platform plans to launch nine new original shows in Tamil language. This series was created as the first series of the Hotstar Specials lineup in 2026.
The series is directed by Ganesh Karthikeyan, written by Aruna Rakhee and producer by A Tele Factory, who previously produced Chinna Thambi, Eeramana Rojave 2 and Heart Beat.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Actor Vikranth play the a Cricket coach Rangan. This is his debut role in a limited series, alongside Akshatha, Daffe Naveen, Niyathi Kadambi, Harish, Sindhu Shyam and Ayaz Khan.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first trailer was released under the banner of South UnBound on 9 December 2025. The first promo was released on 17 December 2025 and revealed the releasing date. On 22 December 2025, was releasing the series song. The series was released on 1 January 2026 in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Hindi, Marathi and Bengali.

episodesList.title: First Innings
episodesList.summary: Rangan, once a celebrated cricket hero, is now working as a PT instructor. Rukmani, the head of MNCA, hopes that new batch of players will help restore the academy’s legacy.

episodesList.title: Campus Oath
episodesList.summary: The juniors take a tour of the academy. Coach Natraj warns to adhere to discipline when the boys’ team returns from a disqualified match. Hostel nights reveal ragging antics.

episodesList.title: Morning Runs
episodesList.summary: Coaches Natraj and Selvam test the players' diving skills and patience after they face Rukmani’s fury for being late. Rukmani battles threats that could shut the academy forever.

episodesList.title: Ghost Practice
episodesList.summary: Falling for the seniors’ ghost tale, the juniors dare each other to pre-dawn practice. Rishi impresses at the nets, making Velu jealous. Mani, Thangam and Theo’s bond gets strong.

episodesList.title: Dream Wakeup
episodesList.summary: Rukmani faces the MNCA’s sponsors who warn about Matheyan’s uncontrolled anger. A fight in the canteen creates cracks between the juniors and seniors. Mani dreams about Thangam.

episodesList.title: Footwork and Footwear
episodesList.summary: Matheyan and Jackie help Mani make a video to impress his dad and get money to buy shoes for Thangam. An astrologer predicts that someone from Rangan’s past will reenter his life.

episodesList.title: Hidden Torture
episodesList.summary: Seniors turn training into bullying, masked as combined drills, leaving Veera terrified. Thangam’s breakthrough in bowling is hidden by strong family pressure to get married.

episodesList.title: Revenge Storm
episodesList.summary: Veera’s gangster father storms MNCA over ragging, forcing Rukmani into a public apology. Rajasekar’s inspection ends with a brutal shutdown threat, and he now vows revenge.

episodesList.title: Mani’s Mission
episodesList.summary: Mani confronts Rukmani about the academy shutting down. Rukmani exposes Rajasekar’s drug expulsion past. Thangam and Rishi worry about their parents’ decision about the academy.

episodesList.title: Pair Up Pressure
episodesList.summary: Theo and Matheyan form senior-junior training pairs. Rangan takes Mani to spy on Anchor Cricket Academy’s high-tech facilities. A kitchen disaster brings Rishi and Thangam closer.

episodesList.title: Hidden Feelings
episodesList.summary: Rukmani is shaken by Rajasekar’s threats. Preparations for the 50th-year alumni gala begin. Mani hides his feelings for Thangam while Rukmani sets to train young Valli in cricket.

episodesList.title: Breaking Point
episodesList.summary: Rangan is shocked to see Thangam’s photo among his marriage proposals. Thangam’s growing discomfort around Rangan leads to accusations and outrage and everyone turns against him.

episodesList.title: Mistakes and Misfires
episodesList.summary: Shattered by Rukmani's mistrust, Rangan nearly quits cricket, but his aunt persuades him to return only to face cold stares. Rukmani later apologises for overreacting.

episodesList.title: Golden Jubilee Begins
episodesList.summary: As the event unfolds, excitement masks rising tensions. Mani lifts Thangam's spirits. Velu's bid to rejoin the team backfires, leading to a clash that Theo halts.

episodesList.title: Shadows of the Past
episodesList.summary: Thulasi's speech revives a painful past tied to Rangan. Shaken by the memories, Rangan retreats. Rukmani finds him and together they step forward to face Thulasi and the truth.

episodesList.title: Rangan’s Return
episodesList.summary: Rukmani firmly shuts Rajasekar down. A tense match sees Velu steady the students until Rangan joins and turns it around. The alumni win, but the academy begins to heal.

episodesList.title: Unspoken Wounds
episodesList.summary: As alumni celebrate Rangan's return, Thangam seethes in silence. Amid cricket talks with the management, Rangan mentions players now battle inner struggles more than the game.

episodesList.title: The Weight of the Past
episodesList.summary: Flashbacks reveal Rangan's fall, a former Ranji captain silenced for opposing injustice. Thulasi introduces a new MNCA scheme. Rangan and Thulasi silently acknowledge their past.

episodesList.title: Lines of Trust
episodesList.summary: When allegations arise against Rangan, Thulasi ensures fairness. Thangam bravely reveals her fear came from family pressure, while Rangan maintains a calm demeanour in response.

episodesList.title: Open Challenge
episodesList.summary: Thangam defends Rangan, while others oppose him. Thulasi and Rukmani plan to save the academy. A cricket match brings peace until Girish and Matheyan ignite a rivalry.

episodesList.title: Cracks in Between
episodesList.summary: Unresolved tension leads to emotional fallout as Mani's jealousy erupts publicly. Meanwhile, Thulasi and Rangan find unexpected comfort in cricket, uncovering past truths.

episodesList.title: Inner Battle
episodesList.summary: Thangam tries to reconcile the differences between Rishi and the boys’ team, but they refuse to heed her words. Meanwhile, Rishi contemplates transferring to another school.

episodesList.title: Unstable Ground
episodesList.summary: Selvam's dismissal plunges the academy into chaos, with Natraj managing both teams. Meanwhile, Rukmani and Rangan uncover sexism and ego during the replacement search.

episodesList.title: Crossing the Boundary
episodesList.summary: What starts as a bold underground match quickly descends into open conflict, leading to chaos and violence. Rangan arrives just in time to prevent history from repeating itself.

episodesList.title: Anger Beneath Bruises
episodesList.summary: Girish fails to threaten Rangan. Rishi doubts himself as Girish provokes him. Rangan hides the injured boys from Ms. Rukmani. Jackie blames Rishi, but the juniors defend him.

episodesList.title: Damage Control
episodesList.summary: The girls hide the boy's wounds, but tension grows when Rukmani sees Rishi bruised. Rangan protects the team despite suspicion. Away from the academy, Rangan confides in Thulasi.

episodesList.title: Dreams, Doubts and a Blowback
episodesList.summary: A counselling session uncovers the dreams of the students as well as Rishi’s feelings. Motivated by Thulasi, Rangan offers support to the students and gains Rukmani’s trust.

episodesList.title: They Are My Team
episodesList.summary: Rangan defends his students against misleading police evidence. Theo’s video unveils the truth, yet the damage persists. Natraj storms out in anger, and Rukmini distrusts Rangan.

episodesList.title: Fault Lines
episodesList.summary: Rangan officially steps in as the coach, but Padma openly rejects him. Natraj’s harsh words humiliate Mani targeting his friendship with Theo. Mani discovers scars on Rishi’s hand.

episodesList.title: Pressure Points
episodesList.summary: Girish faces Rajasekar’s anger over fake evidence. Thulasi encourages Rangan. While Thangam thinks Mani is in love with Theo, Vinay confronts Rukmani over Rishi’s safety.

episodesList.title: Hidden Battles
episodesList.summary: Mani fakes illness to escape the academy ground. He learns about Rishi's hidden struggles and his reluctance toward an acting career imposed by his dad. A bond forms between them.

episodesList.title: Midnight Panic and Confessions
episodesList.summary: Thangam, Matheyan and others search desperately for Mani as he lies drunk on Rishi’s terrace. Next day, on the ground, Mani explodes, confessing his love for a stunned Thangam.

episodesList.title: Shifts and Challenges
episodesList.summary: Mani feels anxious remembering his argument with Thangam. Rishi faces his dad’s pressure to leave cricket. Rangam changes the batting order, facing the wrath of Padma.

episodesList.title: Voices Under Noise
episodesList.summary: Theo turns to Matheyan for advice with the girls’ team. At the nets, Rangan’s intense drills test focus and adaptability. Theo calmly guides Padma. Rishi confesses his fear.

episodesList.title: Silent Drift
episodesList.summary: Thangam worries about her growing feelings for Mani. Rangan seeks Rukmani’s approval for new players. Rishi confides in her about his dad’s plan. Theo and Matheyan share a moment.

episodesList.title: One Last Chance
episodesList.summary: Seeing Valli secretly practicing, Rangan recognises her natural reflexes and determination. Mani pleads with Vinay to give Rishi one chance. Thangam decides to stay away from Mani.

episodesList.title: Closed Gates
episodesList.summary: When Rukmani and the principal can't help Rangan to have Valli join the girls’ team, he contacts Thulasi. While Rishi pushes Mani to focus on cricket, the girls doubt Theo’s moves.

episodesList.title: Unsaid Feelings
episodesList.summary: Thulasi proposes a scheme to Rangan to legitimise Valli’s entry into the team. Rishi trains Mani. Theo and Matheyan sneak out to celebrate his birthday and confess their feelings.

episodesList.title: Surface Fractures
episodesList.summary: During a midnight ride, Theo and Matheyan nearly hit a drunken woman. Later, Rangan introduces Valli to the girls' team, which provokes resistance from most of the team members.

episodesList.title: Shifting Bonds
episodesList.summary: Padma suspects Valli manipulated her way onto the team, but Rangan supports her. Later, Rishi guides Mani through each ball in a practice match.

episodesList.title: Gossip and Revelations
episodesList.summary: Valli endures harsh mockery regarding her background, which also impacts her father. Although she contemplates quitting, Rangan refuses to allow her to give up.

episodesList.title: Confessions
episodesList.summary: Natraj reveals the final lineup and surprises the boys with a celebratory meal. As unity grows, Matheyan confides in Theo about Natraj’s emotionally charged coaching style.

episodesList.title: Unsteady Minds
episodesList.summary: Thangam tells Rangan about Valli's poor practice. Theo and Mani have a disagreement from misunderstandings about their friendship, while Thangam remains unfocused during the match.

episodesList.title: Choices Left Unspoken
episodesList.summary: Thangam, confused by her emotions, explores love online and eventually opens up to Theo. Meanwhile, Mani decides the best way to cope with his intense feelings is to bury them.

episodesList.title: Terrace Party
episodesList.summary: Mani tells everyone he moved on from love to friendship with Thangam. He tricks everyone, including Varsha, into attending a party by falsely stating that it is Rishi's birthday.

episodesList.title: Viral Turn
episodesList.summary: The boys struggle in practice after the party and Nataraj punishes them. To showcase Valli's talent, Rangan records her and posts a social media clip that quickly gains attention.

episodesList.title: Rising Tensions
episodesList.summary: News of an NRI-funded fellowship by Dhoorai sparks rivalry in the academy. The girls tease Rangan about Thulasi, while Rukmani hints she knows about them, making Thulasi shy away.

episodesList.title: Night Unravels
episodesList.summary: Shaken after the practice match, Rishi battles anxiety triggered by Nataraj. Rangan's first visit to Thulasi's house turns tense during an unexpected talk with her grandfather.

episodesList.title: Unseen War
episodesList.summary: Rangan and Thulasi spend time together and she talks about her life with Rajeev. Natraj vows payback after a drunk Rishi attacks his house and hurts him.

episodesList.title: Silent Pressure
episodesList.summary: Rajasekar realises the flaw in his academy. While Natraj targets Rishi, Padma’s selfish gameplay creates cracks in the team. Mani meets Thangam’s parents and wins their trust.

episodesList.title: Sudden Arrival
episodesList.summary: Rishi is shaken by the harsh realities of class divide between students. Rangan’s bold call on field leaves Padma shaken. Matheyan panics when his mother arrives at the academy.

episodesList.title: Facing Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Seeing his drunk mother, Matheyan fears his nightmare may come true. While Theo becomes his anchor, Rangan confronts Natraj and declares that he will stand as Matheyan’s guardian

episodesList.title: Tournament Heat
episodesList.summary: At an event, Rangan's return is celebrated, but Natraj becomes increasingly insecure. Later, Matheyan feels shattered when Natraj publicly removes him as team captain.

episodesList.title: Beginning of the Battle
episodesList.summary: On the field, MNCA starts strong, but Natraj’s provocation hurts Matheyan. MNCA faces a crushing defeat. Rangan helps Matheyan confront his pain. Rukmani faces Rajasekar’s taunts

episodesList.title: Fear to Fire
episodesList.summary: Padma discourages the girls, but Theo shuts her down. MNCA's nerves show early. Despite doubts, Rangan shifts focus to strategy, backing his bowlers and trusting their instincts.

episodesList.title: Falling Apart
episodesList.summary: Velu ignores Matheyan’s suggestion. Rishi chooses to fight his battle. Rukmani confronts Natraj for benching Rishi, his poor decisions and rigid leadership that cost MNCA heavily.

episodesList.title: Narrow Loss
episodesList.summary: As pressure builds before a crucial game, the MNCA boys struggle while the girls deliver a win. Rukmani intervenes in Natraj's decisions, restoring team balance but angering him.

episodesList.title: Momentum Shift
episodesList.summary: Just when the boys think their journey is over, Rangan shows Matheyan a slim chance to qualify. Matheyan then reshapes the batting order, despite Natraj's resistance.

episodesList.title: Silent Sabotage
episodesList.summary: As the MNCA boys' hopes rest on Anchor's results, Girish plays a calculated game, benching his main players. Meanwhile, in the girls' camp, Padma returns with a change of heart.

episodesList.title: Against the Odds
episodesList.summary: Natraj loses his authority and vents his frustrations on the team. He humiliates Matheyan, leading Rukmani to dismiss him. Rangan steps in to assist them.

episodesList.title: Interrupted Moments
episodesList.summary: During a group photo, Theo spots Rangan and Thulasi holding hands. Rishi’s father is happy with his success. Rangan and Thulasi share a moment, but Rukmani’s call interrupts them.

episodesList.title: Rukmani's Treat
episodesList.summary: Rukmani takes the teams for a celebratory dinner. While Rishi flirts with Varsha, Theo exposes Rangan’s secret. As Thangam tries to confess to Mani, a message from Anu stuns all.

episodesList.title: Rumours and Rivalries
episodesList.summary: With no coach for the boys' team, debates over Natraj and Rangan spark clashes. Meanwhile, Thangam grows jealous of Mani's date, with Rishi and Theo secretly stirring trouble.

episodesList.title: Shift in Bonds
episodesList.summary: Rumours swirl about Rangan and Thulasi, leaving them unsettled. Mani's approaching date fuels Thangam's restlessness, pushing her to finally confess her love.

episodesList.title: Awkward Beginnings
episodesList.summary: The boys learn of Thangam's confession to Mani and spread it across the academy. Mani struggles to cope with the news. Meanwhile, Rangan and Thulasi hesitate to text each other.

episodesList.title: Date Plan
episodesList.summary: Matheyan devises a plan to ease Mani's and Thangam's awkwardness. Meanwhile, on the field, Padma's growing isolation leads to emotional outbursts.

episodesList.title: Unsteady Hearts
episodesList.summary: Padma’s sudden move to Anchor shocks the MNCA team, and they feel betrayed. Rangan’s reunion with Dharani helps him release past guilt. Thulasi worries about Rajeev’s threats.

episodesList.title: Triple Date
episodesList.summary: The triple date begins with excitement for Rishi, Varsha, Mani, Thangam, Theo, and Matheyan. Each relationship finds its rhythm, turning unspoken emotions into something real.

episodesList.title: Love and Leverage
episodesList.summary: Rangan helps Matheyan to strengthen their bond. While Padma faces isolation and backlash in her new environment, a viral post turns Thulasi and Rangan’s lives into controversy.

episodesList.title: Silent Battles
episodesList.summary: Rishi asks Matheyan support Rangan through the ongoing controversy. Thulasi faces pressure from the media and her party. Padma begins to feel the emotional cost of her decision.

episodesList.title: Cracks Beneath the Calm
episodesList.summary: Rishi accepts calmly when Varsha decides to leave the academy. Rangan and Rukmani realise Rajasekar is behind the rumours. While Thulasi faces pressure, Girish targets Matheyan.

episodesList.title: Lines Crossed
episodesList.summary: Rajiv’s video as Thulasi’s supportive husband gains sympathy. Matheyan confronts Girish for targeting his mother, while Rangan faces Rajasekhar and declares his stand for Thulasi.

episodesList.title: New Year Break
episodesList.summary: Matheyan struggles with his feelings about his mother. Rukmani calmly manages tensions, advising Rangan. She announces a New Year break to help everyone regain clarity and reset.

episodesList.title: Holiday Begins
episodesList.summary: Love finds room to grow for Mani and Thangam during the break. Theo brings a nervous Matheyan to her home and introduces him to her parents.

episodesList.title: Love Under Pressure
episodesList.summary: Thangam lies to her mother and leaves for Mani's house. At Theo's house, Matheyan faces parental inquisition about his parents, making him uncomfortable and Theo furious.

episodesList.title: Between Holding and Losing
episodesList.summary: Matheyan's deep fear of rejection surfaces during a tense exchange with Theo, making her confront her parents. Thangam's mother realises she is hiding something and warns her.

episodesList.title: Strength and Silence
episodesList.summary: Despite Mani's concern and meddling, Matheyan and Theo struggle with their circumstances. Rangan introduces new training methods to the boys' team.

episodesList.title: The Counter Move
episodesList.summary: Baskar comes prepared with his complaints, but Thulasi is way ahead when she presents video proof. However, Rajasekar has another plan up his sleeve, thanks to Girish.

episodesList.title: Where Hearts Drift
episodesList.summary: Rangan anticipates Rajasekhar's move and has a plan prepared. Triggered by the Anchor boys, a casual game at the local ground turns unpleasant as pride curdles into insecurity.

episodesList.title: The Distance Between Us
episodesList.summary: A light-hearted moment spirals when Jackie takes offence to a casual remark. Rangan attempts to restore unity, but miscommunication and bruised egos continue to widen the rift.

episodesList.title: When Control Slips
episodesList.summary: Tensions explode as Matheyan hits Jackie in front of everyone, leaving both teams shaken. Matheyan later feels guilty, while Jackie is torn between anger and humiliation.

episodesList.title: Cracks Deepen
episodesList.summary: Burdened by team issues, Rangan finds clarity from Thulasi. He helps Matheyan face his family struggles and problems with Jackie, urging resolution over avoidance.

episodesList.title: What Still Matters
episodesList.summary: Thulasi and Rangan enjoy playful moments together in Chennai. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the boys at the academy despite the girls' efforts to help.

episodesList.title: Rangan's Challenge
episodesList.summary: Matheyan visits his mother at a bar, and she promises to quit drinking. At the academy, the seniors accuse Rangan of favouritism, and his challenge leaves him in shock.

episodesList.title: Healing and Breaking
episodesList.summary: Rangan reveals that the girls versus boys match is a strategy to push unity among boys. While Mani isolates himself, ignoring Thangam, Matheyan prepares his mother for rehab.

episodesList.title: Emotion vs Ego
episodesList.summary: Mani and Thangam try to outperform each other during practice. Hurt turns into determination when the girls realise the boys are looking down on them.

episodesList.title: Mind Over Momentum
episodesList.summary: The girls begin intense training to secure a victory over the boys. Meanwhile, the boys' team faces challenges due to changes and instability within the team.

episodesList.title: Deal with Divide
episodesList.summary: Amid the challenges faced by the boys' team and their ongoing conflict with the girls' team, Mani receives an offer from Velu. Will this proposal disrupt or resolve the conflict?

episodesList.title: The Cost of Pride
episodesList.summary: As the girls thrive on unity and leadership, the boys struggle to find common ground. Will teamwork triumph, or will the boys rise above their differences?

episodesList.title: Last Ball, Last Chance
episodesList.summary: The girls win against the odds, while the boys face the consequences of their mistakes. Mani and Thangam reconcile, but Thangam's possessiveness sparks tension with Anu.

episodesList.title: When Everything Falls Apart
episodesList.summary: Matheyan and Jackie put their differences aside and reunite, surprising everyone. Meanwhile, Anu's world is turned upside down by a sudden expulsion from Anchor Academy.

episodesList.title: Dreams or Duty?
episodesList.summary: Anu starts a new chapter at MNCA as Theo feels jealous about her arrival. Rishi makes the difficult decision to quit cricket to support his father through a financial crisis.

episodesList.title: Between Missing and Moving On
episodesList.summary: The academy struggles to move on after Rishi's departure. When exam dates are announced, cricket takes a backseat. Meanwhile, Thulasi heads into a crucial divorce hearing.

episodesList.title: When Silence Hurts
episodesList.summary: Exam pressure replaces cricket. The juniors desperately search for study notes and help. Thulasi's divorce hearing takes a major setback when Rajeev refuses a mutual separation.

episodesList.title: Preparation and Crisis
episodesList.summary: Velu orders the seniors to not help the juniors, but two of them ignore him. Rangan receives a golden opportunity, but the situation gets worse for his beloved MNCA and Rukmani.

episodesList.title: MNCA Under Threat
episodesList.summary: As Rangan hunts for sponsors, the MNCA crisis snowballs, leading to a meeting with the trustees. Anu and Jackie bond over physics, creating tension between Mani and Thangam.

episodesList.title: Renewed Hope
episodesList.summary: The exams finally arrive. Thangam receives good news, which becomes a welcome respite for the academy. Rukmani begins accepting MNCA's possible end, but Rangan stays hopeful.

episodesList.title: Costly Clash
episodesList.summary: Theo's parents visit her at the academy, but she misunderstands their intentions. While Rangan gives a tour to a potential investor, an unwelcome sight greets them.

episodesList.title: Love in Fragments
episodesList.summary: Matheyan rejoices as his mother slowly returns to her old self. At the advertisement shoot, Thangam and Girish grow closer, stirring jealousy in Mani.

episodesList.title: Weight of Staying
episodesList.summary: Anu steals the spotlight in a practice match, leaving Thangam jealous, especially as Mani cheers for her. Elsewhere, Rangan is shaken upon learning about the attack on Thulasi.

episodesList.title: Under Evaluation
episodesList.summary: Rangan spends a restless night, troubled by the unachievable condition he imposed on the Chennai club. Later, Matheyan is deeply unsettled by his mother's unexpected health scare.

episodesList.title: Before Impact
episodesList.summary: Rukmani shocks Rangan by deciding to sell MNCA's assets. Meanwhile, competition drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu, while Anu and Thangam clash openly on the field.

episodesList.title: Hearts Start to Align
episodesList.summary: As tensions build across the academy, personal bonds start affecting the game. Rangan reveals the funding deal with Chennai Club to Rukmani and later shares it with Thulasi.

episodesList.title: Shifting Equations
episodesList.summary: Thangam confronts Mani over his lies, straining their relationship. Kalyani collapses during practice and shocks Rangan by revealing that she is pregnant.

episodesList.title: Choice Within
episodesList.summary: As Kalyani faces an unexpected pregnancy and a life-changing choice, Rangan helps her find her answer. Meanwhile, growing selection pressure drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu.

episodesList.title: Shift in Play
episodesList.summary: Kalyani's absence leaves the girls' team struggling. Mani's growing insecurity over Girish drives a wedge between him and Thangam, hurting both their relationship and their game.

episodesList.title: Words That Hurt
episodesList.summary: As Kalyani's departure weighs heavily on Rangan, he lashes out at Thulasi. Her emotional distress quickly becomes the subject of discussion at her workplace.

episodesList.title: Practice, Pressure, Promises
episodesList.summary: Worried the academy is nearing its end, Matheyan plans a surprise proposal for Theo with Mani and Thangam's help. But Matheyan's bike crashes, leaving her with a knee injury.

episodesList.title: Parallel Hearts
episodesList.summary: After Matheyan's proposal, he and Theo revel in their new relationship, while Mani and Thangam fight. The academy travels to Chennai for its most significant challenge yet.

episodesList.title: One Team, Many Battles
episodesList.summary: Rangan mocks the team's low spirits, but Theo stands by them and tries to light up the mood. A stop at a Dhaba turns chaotic as a clash with Anchor Academy erupts into a fight.

episodesList.title: Her Birthday, His Forever
episodesList.summary: Mani and Thangam decide not to speak until the tournament ends. Rangan's birthday proposal plans for Thulasi take an unexpected turn after Rajeev humiliates them.

episodesList.title: Beyond the Game
episodesList.summary: Jackie uncovers MNCA's financial crisis and Rangan's secret sacrifice for the academy. Meanwhile, disaster strikes as Theo suffers a serious knee injury, ruling her out for weeks.

episodesList.title: Out of Sync
episodesList.summary: Anu's surprise captaincy takes a tense turn when a crucial call involving Thangam sparks misunderstandings between the two. Later, Rajasekhar's taunts rile up Rangan and Rukmani.

episodesList.title: Double Pressure
episodesList.summary: A sudden schedule shake-up catches the MNCA girl's off guard. Clashing egos and crumbling teamwork push the boys to the edge against Madurai Hawks.

episodesList.title: What Makes a Team
episodesList.summary: MNCA's internal conflict costs them another match, revealing Rangan's fierce side. Matheyan's and Rangan's guidance encourages the team to confront their egos and insecurities.

episodesList.title: Us vs Them
episodesList.summary: Rangan motivates the teams. With the chase collapsing, Matheyan delivers a breathtaking win and takes MNCA into the quarterfinals. Amid celebrations, Jackie gets devastating news.

episodesList.title: The Quarter-Final Storm
episodesList.summary: Mani and Thangam's relationship reaches a painful breaking point. The girls fight through a tense quarterfinal. On the boys' side, Mani's early exit intensifies the pressure.

episodesList.title: When Life Demands More
episodesList.summary: Theo receives clearance to rejoin the girls' team as captain. Disaster strikes when Jackie learns Matheyan's mother is in critical condition, forcing Matheyan to rush home.

episodesList.title: Unsaid Goodbyes
episodesList.summary: Just before the finals, Matheyan faces the darkest moment of his life. Although Rangan stands by him through this tough time, panic spreads when Matheyan suddenly goes missing.

episodesList.title: A Legacy Reborn
episodesList.summary: Despite Matheyan's disappearance, Rangan pushes the team forward, reminding them what's at stake. Meanwhile, Matheyan fulfils his late mother's last wish on her birthday.

title: Loot Kaand
summary: Loot Kaand (transl. Robbery Scandal) is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language action drama television series directed by Ruchir Arun. Produced under Drishyam Films and N2O Films, it stars Tanya Maniktala, Sahil Mehta and  Gyanendra Tripathi. The series premiered on 20 March 2025 on Amazon MX Player.
reception:
Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com awarded the series 2/5 stars and said that Loot Kaand tries to concoct a crime drama that arouses some curiosity but is instantly forgettable". Vinamra Mathur of the Firstpost gave the series 3 stars out of 5 and satated that "Loot Kaand is like that dish that satiates the appetite but leaves you wondering if you’d like to have it again when hunger arrives at your doorstep.". Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated it 3/5 stars and said that "If you’re looking for a crime drama with an unconventional heist at its center, 'Loot Kaand' is worth a watch."
Shaheen Irani of OTT Play rated it 3/5 stars and siad that "Loot Kaand takes time but gets interesting in bits-and-pieces. While it is not a series that demands all of your attention, this one can be streamed because of its cliffhanger endings." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in observed that "Loot Kaand merrily gallops from one twist to the next, hoping that nobody will notice how contrived it is." Troy Ribeiro of Free Press Journal rated it 3.5/5 stars and commented that it is a "Grit And Guns In A Promising Crime Drama."

title: Love Under Construction
summary: Love Under Construction is an Indian Malayalam-language romantic comedy television series directed by Vishnu G Raghav starring Neeraj Madhav, Aju Varghese, Gouri G. Kishan, Anand Manmadhan and Ann Saleem in lead roles. The series premiered on 28 February 2025 on JioHotstar.
plot: The series revolve around Vinod, who wishes to construct his own house, ignoring his financial instability. While he wants to marry the girl he loves (Gouri), he has to face challenges, both from her parents and their society.
reception: The series received positive reviews from critics and audience. Divya P of OTTPlay rated the series 3 out of 5 stars and wrote:"Neeraj Madhav builds on Vishnu Raghav's solid comedy-drama series". Vishal Menon of The Hollywood Reporter wrote:"Neeraj Madhav Stars in This Neatly-Written, Passive Viewing Comedy ".Vignesh Madhu of Cinema Express wrote:"This modern-day Mithunam-Varavelpu cocktail leaves a sweet aftertaste". Dhanya K Vilayil of The Indian Express wrote:"'Love Under Construction' gives Bright perspectives, natural performances". Latha Srinivasan of Hindustan Times wrote:"Neeraj Madhav and Aju Varghese keep us engaged in this comedy drama".

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series directed by Vishnu G Raghav, known for his debut film Vaashi was announced in September 2023. The series began filming on 3 October 2023 and wrapped up on 21 January 2024.

title: Lovely Lolla
summary: Lovely Lolla is an Indian romantic comedy drama series produced by Sargun Mehta and Ravi Dubey for their entertainment channel Dreamiyata Dramaa. It stars Isha Malviya, Gauahar Khan and Nikhil Khurana as Lovely Chaddha, Lolla Chawla and Arjun Malhotra. The series aired from 25 December 2024 to 1 May 2025 on YouTube.
plot: Lovely and Lolla are a mother-daughter duo with a complicated relationship. Lovely and Lolla are full of life but not with each other. Dilemma occurs when their bond sees the real battle as they both set their sights on the same person Arjun. Watch them as their love, rivalry, and family drama unfold in this rollercoaster series with lots of fun, comedy and real entertainment. Lovely is a 21 year old employee who works at Mantraz to pay the bills and keep things afloat. Lolla is a 39 year old film star and Lovely's mother. Arjun is a 37 year old businessman and the CEO of Mantraz.

articleSections.title: Release and casting
articleSections.text: The trailer of the series was released on 14 December 2024 and the first episode aired on 25 December 2024. Isha Malviya was cast to play Lovely Chaddha, a simple and sharp girl who has never received love from her parents. Gauahar Khan was cast as Vaishnavi "Lolla" Chawla, an actress and star who does not value other people's emotions and leaves her own daughter behind. Dolly Ahluwalia plays Shakuntala Chawla, Lolla's mother and Lovely's grandmother. Nikhil Khurana plays Arjun Malhotra, Lovely's boss and love interest as well as Lolla's former one-sided lover who she left years ago.

title: Lakshmi Niwas
summary: Lakshmi Niwas (transl. Lakshmi's Residence) is an Indian Marathi language television series which airing on Zee Marathi. It stars Tushar Dalvi and Harshada Khanvilkar in lead roles. It is produced by Sunil Bhosale under the banner of Someel Creations. The series premiered from 23 December 2024 by replacing Satvya Mulichi Satavi Mulgi. It is an official remake of Zee Kannada's TV series Lakshmi Nivasa.
plot: Lakshmi, a strong-willed woman who willingly forfeits a life of wealth to marry Shriniwas Dalvi for love. Anchored within a middle-class, traditional joint family, the resilient couple dedicates their lives to a singular, unyielding dream: building an independent house of their own, titled "Lakshmi Niwas." As they navigate financial hurdles, domestic sacrifices, and family disputes, their endurance is put to the test through the turbulent marriages of their daughters. Their elder daughter, Bhavana, must constantly defend her integrity and marital rights against the orthodox pride of her elite rural in-laws, the Gade-Patils. Meanwhile, their younger daughter, Janhavi, silently suffers the toxic, manipulative abuse of her husband Jayant. Relying on her strong moral compass, Lakshmi serves as the protective shield of her family, striving to rescue her daughters from domestic exploitation while steadfastly pursuing her husband's dream of a home.

'मुलगी झाली हो' फेम अभिनेत्री 'झी मराठी'च्या नव्या मालिकेत झळकणार! 'लक्ष्मी निवास'ची संपूर्ण स्टारकास्ट आली समोर…

घराचं स्वप्न बघणाऱ्या प्रत्येकाची गोष्ट! झी मराठीची नवी मालिका 'लक्ष्मी निवास', हर्षदा खानविलकर दिसणार मुख्य भूमिकेत
‘लक्ष्मी निवास’च्या प्रोमोमध्ये दिसली दुसरी मुलगी; अखेर अशी झाली दिव्या पुगावकरची निवड
'लहान मुलांना असा त्रास देऊ नका' नुकत्याच सुरू झालेल्या 'लक्ष्मी निवास' मालिकेवर संतापले प्रेक्षक
लक्ष्मी-श्रीनिवास तुरुंगात…; लेक भावनामुळे ओढवलं मोठं संकट! ‘त्या’ निर्णयाचा झाला ‘असा’ परिणाम, पाहा प्रोमो
'लक्ष्मी निवास' मालिकेत आणखी एका अभिनेत्याची एन्ट्री; साकारणार धमाकेदार भूमिका
जयंतच्या विचित्र वागण्यानंतर जान्हवीचा मोठा निर्णय, 'लक्ष्मी निवास'चा प्रोमो पाहून नेटकरी म्हणाले...
स्टार प्रवाहच्या अभिनेत्याची 'लक्ष्मी निवास' मालिकेत एन्ट्री; प्रोमो पाहून चाहत्यांची उत्सुकता शिगेला
जयंतचा भयंकर भूतकाळ! अखेर जान्हवीला समजणार विकृत नवऱ्याचं मोठं सत्य, ‘ती’ व्यक्ती ठरली कारणीभूत, पाहा प्रोमो…
अखेर जान्हवीची सुटका झाली! विकृत जयंतच्या घरातून काढला पळ, लूकही बदलला; ‘या’ व्यक्तीला भेटणार…; पाहा प्रोमो
‘लक्ष्मी निवास’मध्ये मोठा ट्विस्ट! अखेर जान्हवी-विश्वाला जयंत एकत्र पाहणार, जानूवर घेणार भलताच संशय? पाहा प्रोमो…
झुरळ खाल्लं, मित्राला मारहाण, कठोर शिक्षा अन्…; अखेर जान्हवी शोधणार विकृत जयंतचा भूतकाळ! होणार मोठा खुलासा, पाहा प्रोमो…
लक्ष्मी निवास : जयंत करतोय जान्हवीचा छळ! आता करणार असं काही…; नायकाची विकृती पाहून नेटकरी म्हणाले, “सगळ्यात मूर्ख…”
‘लक्ष्मी निवास’मध्ये फिल्मी ट्विस्ट! भावनाचा अपमान अन् सिद्धूच्या हातून नकळत घडणार असं काही…; नेटकरी झाले खूश, पाहा प्रोमो
लेकीच्या सासरी पोहोचले लक्ष्मी अन् श्रीनिवास! जान्हवीला अश्रू अनावर, तर विकृत जयंत करणार असं काही…; पाहा प्रोमो
“बंद करा हा फालतूपणा…”, जयंतचा विकृतपणा पाहून प्रेक्षक कंटाळले, जान्हवीलाच ठरवलं ‘महामूर्ख’, प्रोमोवर कमेंट्सचा पाऊस

भावना सिद्धूची माफी मागणार तर जयंत …; प्रोमो पाहताच नेटकरी म्हणाले, “सकारात्मकता हवी…”
भावनाला त्रास देणाऱ्या बॉसला सिद्धूने शिकवला धडा; ‘लक्ष्मी निवास’चा प्रोमो पाहून नेटकरी म्हणाले, “अशा मुलांची आज खूप…”
जयंतने सांगितला 'लक्ष्मी निवास' मालिकेतील जान्हवीच्या बर्थडे सीनचा मजेशीर किस्सा

“मला जयंतवर सूड…”, जान्हवी सांगणार विश्वाला ‘ते’ सत्य; ‘लक्ष्मी निवास’ मालिकेत मोठा ट्विस्ट
