title: Laakhon Mein Ek
summary: Laakhon Mein Ek (transl. One in a Million) is an Indian television series created by Biswa Kalyan Rath produced by OML Production. It is an Amazon Prime Video original series. Season 1 premiered on October 13, 2017, premise of the series revolved around the struggles of Aakash, a teenage student from Raipur who is sent to a coaching centre Genius Infinity in Visakhapatnam for preparation of IIT entrance exam. Season 2 premiered on April 12, 2019, and was about Dr. Shreya and her fight with government for healthcare in Sitlapur Village.
reception: Laakhon Mein Ek received mixed critical feedback. Rahul Desai of the Film Companion gave three stars out of five to the show, and wrote that "it's the mechanics of this atmosphere – the specifics and little details – that makes this show more lived-in than its mainstream companions". Mid Day's Letty Mariam Abraham wrote that "Laakhon Mein Ek is a powerful drama" and gave it two and a half stars out of five. The Quint's Megha Mathur wrote that "[it] [f]eels like Biswa got a little lazy while writing the end" and "Laakhon Mein Ek is no unique take on Indian parenting and education, but I wish Biswa’s edgy humour had translated into a more satirical and dark drama that stood out in the crowd". Akhil Sood of The Hindu wrote that "Laakhon Mein Ek is not without its flaws — for starters, basing its very premise on an overdone subject — but it succeeds in its raw depiction of a life that leaves lakhs of embittered students in its wake". FirstPost's Utkarsh Srivastava praised the show's music and background score as "top notch" but criticised the show's writing saying that "[s]adly, Laakhon Mein Ek disappoints on the very front it was expected to do well: the writing", and "Biswa cannot translate his comedy gifts into a solid drama storyline". Sampada Sharma of The Indian Express also praised the sound design and said that it is "honestly quite refreshing" to watch the show. Kritika Dua of the Daily Pioneer gave four stars out of five to the show. Aditya Mani Jha of the DailyO praised the show's writing, cinematography and actors' acting and wrote that "Laakhon Mein Ek is a success, smartly written, competently shot with a no-frills aesthetic, and brilliantly acted".

articleSections.text:
Quote box|width=35%|It started out as a comedy, but slowly through the writing process, we understood that this is not a story for a comedy. If we have to stay true to their world and the characters, we will have to sacrifice the comedy. We were more than willing to do whatever the story deserves. When asked about the casting process, Biswa credits his director, saying that he "wanted to keep it realistic by not making a 22-year-old play an 18-year-old". Sengupta said that "[w]e really lucked out with the boys — Aakash, Bakri, and Chudail (the three protagonists)" and "we wanted to have people who could relate to the characters. Aakash Agarwal handled the cinematography and the production designer was Prashant Bidkar. Ruby Thakur served as the Executive Producer. Shruti Rao and Tihany Sengupta served as the supervising producers".
Biswa started writing Season Two almost immediately after the release of Season One. Collaborating with director Abhishek Sengupta and writer Hussian Haidry, they had innumerable conversations with several medical professionals and public health practitioners to write this story. Aakash Agarwal handled the cinematography, costumer designer was Shivani Shivkumar and the production designer was Snehi Shah. Varsha Venkatesan served as the Executive Producer for the Second Season along with Tihany Sengupta as the supervising producer.

articleSections.text: Laakhon Mein Ek received mixed critical feedback. Rahul Desai of the Film Companion gave three stars out of five to the show, and wrote that "it's the mechanics of this atmosphere – the specifics and little details – that makes this show more lived-in than its mainstream companions". episodesList.title: Projectile
episodesList.summary: Aakash Gupta wants to be a mimicry artist and an internet sensation. He got 55 percent marks in his board exams and his name wasn't in the first two lists of accepted students for a college. His father sends him away to Genius Infinity, a coaching institute, to prepare for IIT entrance exams despite Aakash being against it.

episodesList.title: Equilibrium
episodesList.summary: Aakash is consistently getting high marks and topping section D. Chudail advises Aakash to intentionally get low marks occasionally so he doesn't raise suspicion but Aakash brushes him off. They visit the peon to get cigarettes, chocolates, chips and dawai (slang for a drug that helps students to stay awake late at night and study). The peon hands over first three items but informs them that dawai is unavailable as Moorthy is getting very strict because CBSE inspectors are visiting. Bala summons every student to mess, where Moorthy announces that Aakash is getting promoted to section A for his hard work. Aakash informs his father about this, who tells him not get overconfident and study hard. He shifts to room A2, where Krishna used to stay and Chandu currently stays. Aakash decides that he'll not cheat anymore and study on his own. Chandu tries to humiliate Aakash in the mess by asking a physics question when Aakash says that "they're on the same level" but this backfires when instead of answering the question, Aakash asks questions about Indian cinema. Aakash tries to study honestly for next exam but he's too far behind the syllabus and unable to catch up. In the exam he sees Chudail and Bakri going to the toilet to cheat and decides that he'll cheat too and goes to the toilet. Chandu gets suspicious and he goes after Aakash and finds the cheat sheet. He runs to Moorthy's office with the sheet, where Moorthy is talking to CBSE inspectors about the license to become an official college.

episodesList.title: Entropy
episodesList.summary: Aakash wants to kill himself by jumping off the terrace but Bakri persuades Aakash not to. Aakash tells Bakri that he really wants to escape Genius Infinity immediately. They go outside and find that every hostel room for section D is locked and that the whole section A is getting escorted somewhere else. Bakri starts unlocking the locked hostel doors and Aakash starts hitting the locked front gate when another section A student sees him and loudly announces that a section D student is outside. Aakash starts hitting that boy when Bala comes and throws Aakash off and starts beating Aakash. Section D students start gathering around Aakash and Bala. Aakash starts yelling "Bala is a motherfucker" repeatedly. Other section D students start attacking Bala, leaving him badly injured. This starts a hostel wide riot and police is called. The institute's principal tells the inspector to just arrest the section D boys and only cut out the parts where section A boys are seen from the CCTV footage. Upon overhearing this, Aakash destroys the CPU. He gets escorted back to his home where his friends inform him that his name was in the third list and he was selected for the commerce college. He confronts his father about why they lied to him and didn't tell him about the acceptance letter. They get in an argument and his father tells him that he'll have to study science in a local university and prepare for IIT in a local coaching institute. Aakash runs away from his home in the night.

title: Lal Salam
summary: Lal Salam is an Indian entertainment talk show hosted by actor Mohanlal on Amrita TV. The show is themed around Mohanlal's film career, it also introduces and honours humanitarians and social workers, and has other interactive and performance segments. It is the first television presentation by Mohanlal, hosted alongside Meera Nandan. The show premiered on Amrita TV on 18 August 2017, it telecast every Saturday and Sunday at 8:00 PM IST.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text:
Lal Salam has different segments – each episode is dedicated to a renowned film of Mohanlal. Co-actors, producers, directors and other colleagues who have associated with Mohanlal in the film come to a single platform to discuss various aspects of the film such as their experience working with Mohanlal, the hard work and effort that went into the making of these films and the fun and lighter moments on the sets during the shoot of the film. The audience gets to witness these funny interactions between the actor and his colleagues.
The show also has a segment where an ardent fan of actor Mohanlal will be given an opportunity to meet him in person on the channel's platform. Another major segment of the show honours social workers, uniformed men and other people who have done humanitarian deeds or selfless acts of service. Such personalities are invited to the show, introduced to the audience and Lal meets and honours them on stage.
Lal Salam includes music, dance and other special performance by each guest artiste who presents his/her work.

title: Love Ka Hai Intezaar
summary:
Love Ka Hai Intezaar (transl. Waiting for Love) is an Indian Hindi-language television romantic drama series, produced by Siddharth P. Malhotra. It was broadcasting worldwide on Star Plus, Mondays through Saturdays in an afternoon programming block called Star Dopahar. Sanjeeda Sheikh, Keith Sequeira and Sara Arfeen Khan. The show took a twenty-year leap after which Preetika Rao and Mohit Sehgal joined the cast.
The series ended on 30 September 2017 when the "Star Dopahar" block was discontinued.

articleSections.title: Summary
articleSections.text:
actress Kamini Mathur is at the peak of her career. Although assumed as a Bollywood diva, she is simple in her personal lives. Born to an IAS officer father Naman and artist mother Ragini, she has her middle-class values firmly in place.
Hardworking towards her values and talent, Kamini meets the righteous and ideal Madhav Ranawat, the king of Rajgarh who fulfills his duties well and is surrounded by luxuries. He is married and has a three-year-old girl, Madhavi. Passionately, Kamini and Madhav fall in love.
Madhav decides to divorce his wife Vijayalakshmi, who separates them. Pregnant, Kamini decides to raise her child separately. Mathurs move to Canada for sometime so she delivers her baby that will be introduced as her sibling to the world.

articleSections.title: 20 years later
articleSections.text:
Retired from public life, Kamini lives with her family including her daughter Mohini and the widowed Ragini in Mumbai. Mohini assumes Kamini to be her sister. Madhavi is also grown up. Enters Ayaan Mehta, for whom Mohini and Madhavi fall but he has feelings for Mohini.
Madhav and Kamini meet each other. The misunderstandings sort out. Madhav accepts Mohini; Vijayalakshmi is exposed. Kamini realises he broke up with her in a letter so it would be easy for her to hate him and move on. They unite. Madhavi realises where Madhav's true happiness lies and that Ayaan and Mohini are meant to be together.

title: Lakshmi Kalyanam
summary: Lakshmi Kalyanam (transl. Lakshmi Wedding) is an Indian Tamil-language soap opera starring Yuvarani, Deepika, Sathiya Sai, Ashwin Kumar and Shyam. It is a remake of the Telugu-language television series of the same title which has aired on Maa TV from 2016. It was broadcast on Vijay TV on Monday to Friday from 7 February 2017 to 23 June 2017 at 21:30 (IST) for 98 Episodes. It replaced Kalyanam Mudhal Kadhal Varai.
plot: It is a story about two sisters Lakshmi and Swathi who lost their mother early in their life. Lakshmi looks after her sister and runs an embroidery store to support the family and fund Swathi's education but, after she makes a big sacrifice for Swathi, there are consequences for them all.

title: Little Things
summary: Little Things is an Indian romantic comedy television series, created by Dhruv Sehgal, who also starred in the lead role along with Mithila Palkar. The series were directed by Ajay Bhuyan and Ruchir Arun and produced by Aditi Shrivastava, Anirudh Pandita and Ashwin Suresh of Dice Media. Its first season was premiered through the official YouTube channel of Dice Media, from 25 October 2016, to 22 November. Netflix later purchased the franchise and its second season and third, was premiered on 5 October 2018 and 9 November 2019. Its fourth and the final season was released on 15 October 2021.
plot: The story revolves around Kavya Kulkarni (Palkar) and Dhruv Vats (Sehgal), a couple in a live-in relationship in Mumbai. The series progresses with everyday life explored through conversation between the couple. The language used is English, with a few sentences in Hindi (used mostly in slang).
reception: Rohan Naahar of Hindustan Times gave it a rating of 4/5 and went on to write "[The show] relies more heavily on performances than most others". Prakhya Nair of The Red Sparrow rated it 3.5 stars and recommended it to "anyone who wants to delve in a real relationship for a while".

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Mithila Palkar as Kavya Kulkarni * Dhruv Sehgal as Dhruv Vats

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Dhruv Sehgal, started writing for the new series in late 2015, featuring Mithila Palkar who have previously acted in short videos by Dice Media and Filter Copy, The series' first season was directed by Ajay Bhuyan and had an episode runtime of 15 minutes each. The series is produced by Aditi Shrivastava, Anirudh Pandita and Ashwin Suresh. The second and third season was directed by Ruchir Arun, who is a National Award winner.

articleSections.title: Themes
articleSections.text:
The series explores multiple themes, related to everyday life and the problems and challenges faced in it. Season 1 explored themes like a fear of missing out (FOMO) caused by social media and late-night cravings for food. Season 2 explored more serious themes like personal and professional crises. Dhruv is seen reconnecting with an old friend and realising that they have grown apart. He is later seen quitting his job due to a loss of interest. Dhruv is then seen as being "aimless" while Kavya has received a promotion and a pay hike, which leads to fights as they realise the differences between them. Other themes explored in the second season include Kavya getting attracted to a biker on an office trip, homophobia and the possibility of considering one's parents as friends.
Season 3 further explores Dhruv and Kavya's relationship (which had hit a rough patch at the end of Season 2) with them venturing into a long-distance relationship. They thus begin to face loneliness (due to staying apart from one another) and learn to deal with it. They eventually realize that they can also be happy with other people. The two of them also have additional responsibilities and pity themselves. They reconnect with childhood friends and Kavya faces the fear of losing a loved one, her neighbour's dog, Kaju. They both discuss the possibility of marriage and their views on the topic are explored through an episode consisting of flashbacks. While visiting their parents, they realize that they are growing old. Additionally, the season explores the social structures of the big cities, commenting on how the urbanisation results in a loss of humanity.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first season of the series was premiered through Dice Media's YouTube channel, from 25 October 2016 to 22 November 2016. It became a thundering success, with the first episode, which premiered on 25 October, gained over 15 million views, upon its initial release. which was released on 5 October 2018. Netflix announced that the show would be renewed for a third season, with a release date of 9 November 2019.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Rohan Naahar of Hindustan Times gave it a rating of 4/5 and went on to write "[The show] relies more heavily on performances than most others". Prakhya Nair of The Red Sparrow rated it 3.5 stars and recommended it to "anyone who wants to delve in a real relationship for a while".

articleSections.title: Other media
articleSections.text: Season 1 of the series was published as a book by Penguin Random House in August 2017. A 20-episode prequel audio series Little Things: Jab Dhruv Met Kavya narrated by Sehgal and Palkar was released on Audible in September 2022.

episodesList.title: FOMO
episodesList.summary: Dhruv and Kavya are on course to have a lazy plain Sunday even though they try their best to make it exciting. The fear of missing out on all the fun that they see their friends are having on social media makes Kavya spice up their day.

episodesList.title: Have a Nice Day
episodesList.summary: The morning rush to go to work leads to a tussle between Dhruv and Kavya, spoiling both their moods for the rest of the day. As the irony of relationships goes, however, they still have each other to help fix a bad day.

episodesList.title: Good Night
episodesList.summary: A sleepless night thanks to mosquitoes turns into a discovery that Kavya's ex-boyfriend is getting married, and a long conversation about exes follows.

episodesList.title: Thank You!
episodesList.summary: It is a weeknight and Dhruv and Kavya's plan to have a good dinner at an Iranian restaurant gets canned. Kavya convinces Dhruv to attend her friend Shifa's house party and in the end, they end up having a late night out at a nearby fair.

episodesList.title: Here We Go!
episodesList.summary: Fresh air and wine do wonders for Dhruv and Kavya as they open up like never before. Nestled in the middle of a vineyard, Kavya speaks her heart out to Dhruv about how she doesn't know what she wants to do with her life.

episodesList.title: Milk Cake
episodesList.summary: When an old friend comes to visit from Delhi, Dhruv is struck by how much has changed between them since their childhood.

episodesList.title: Back Seat
episodesList.summary: After Kavya gets a big work promotion and Dhruv makes a difficult professional decision, they attend the housewarming party of a well-to-do couple.

episodesList.title: Cheeti Aur Haathi
episodesList.summary: Kavya gets busier at work while managing a big project. Feeling restless at home, Dhruv struggles to find ways to bring in some income.

episodesList.title: Mumbai Darshan
episodesList.summary: When Kavya's mother comes to visit, Dhruv takes her out for the afternoon and learns more about the person behind the parent.

episodesList.title: Leicester City F.C.
episodesList.summary: When Kavya hits it off with another man on a work trip, she begins questioning whether her relationship with Dhruv is good enough for the long haul.

episodesList.title: Bed & Breakfast
episodesList.summary: With Kavya feeling under the weather, weekend plans are cancelled in favour of a day at home, where she and Dhruv chill, chat and occasionally quarrel.

episodesList.title: Baalti Aur Magga
episodesList.summary: While attending a friend's wedding, a moment of intimacy between Kavya and Dhruv devolves into a full-blown argument about where they stand.

episodesList.title: Where Are We?
episodesList.summary: Following their fight, Kavya and Dhruv return home from the wedding, stopping at a familiar place for a heart-to-heart talk.

episodesList.title: Migration
episodesList.summary: A research stint takes Dhruv to Bangalore. As Kavya helps him settle in, unease over their upcoming months apart affects their remaining hours together.

episodesList.title: Today of all Days
episodesList.summary: Dhruv quickly takes to his new surroundings and makes instant friends. Kavya struggles with loneliness at home and vulnerability at work.

episodesList.title: Rectangles
episodesList.summary: Dhruv and Kavya grow accustomed to their individual lives. As Dhruv's fellowship ends, an awkward conversation stirs unease about his return to Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Senior Citizens
episodesList.summary: While visiting her hometown in Nagpur, Kavya's interactions with her ageing parents and childhood friends spark both concern and nostalgia.

episodesList.title: Vertical Housing
episodesList.summary: Dhruv visits Delhi to help his mother pack up his childhood home, but pressure to marry and family tensions have him feeling frustrated and detached.

episodesList.title: Jet Lag
episodesList.summary: The couple is finally reunited, but life seems out of sync as Dhruv compares Mumbai to Bangalore and feels replaced by Kavya's new friendships.

episodesList.title: The Sum of our Past
episodesList.writer: Dhruv Sehgal, Garima Pura Patiyaalvi, Abhinandan Sridhar
episodesList.summary: Flashbacks illuminate each of Dhruv's and Kavya's early encounters with relationships and marriage. In the present day, a wedding ring triggers tension.

episodesList.title: Migration II
episodesList.summary: Dhruv envies a friend's accomplishment. As sad news compels Kavya to consider transferring to Nagpur, the couple reflect on their evolving relationship.

episodesList.title: Circles
episodesList.summary: Reunited after 14 months, Kavya and Dhruv reflect on their time apart, wondering if the physical distance created an emotional disconnection, too.

episodesList.title: Family Holiday
episodesList.summary: On their Kerala holiday, Kavya talks a reluctant Dhruv into taking a bus tour, but the day trip isn’t without a few bumps in the road.

episodesList.title: Fort Kavya
episodesList.summary: When Dhruv is unable to get out of a work commitment on Kavya’s 30th birthday, she spends the occasion in her own company, exploring and soul-searching.

episodesList.title: Air Quality Index
episodesList.summary: Kavya makes a brave career move. A meetup with Dhruv’s friends from Finland sparks questions about the future and why Dhruv really moved back to India.

episodesList.title: Business Class
episodesList.summary: While setting up their new home in Mumbai, Dhruv and Kavya discuss the pros and cons of marriage. An accident leads to a disappointing setback.

episodesList.title: Got Your Back
episodesList.summary: With Kavya listless at home and Dhruv struggling at work, three weeks pass before they realize the toll these things have taken on their relationship..

episodesList.title: What's This Party For?
episodesList.writer: Dhruv Sehgal, Garima Pura Patiyaalvi, Abhinandan Sridhar
episodesList.summary: While both sets of parents are visiting, Kavya and Dhruv host a gathering at home with friends — but no one is quite sure what the occasion is.

episodesList.title: Full Circle
episodesList.summary: In a merry mood, the couple enjoys a late night out, taking a pause to celebrate the present moment as they stand on the cusp of big things to come.

summary:

Surya TV launched the second season of show from 2 April 2017 in a new format as a kids reality show. Jyothi Krishna hosts the show.
Surya TV launched the third season of show from 18 May 2018 as movie promotion talk show. Gayathri Arun hosts the show.

title: Life Sahi Hai
summary:
Life Sahi Hai (transl. Life is right) is an Indian coming-of-age comedy series created by Tarun Jain. It is produced by Luv Ranjan and Ankur Garg under their production company, Luv Films. Several team members involved in the series had previously worked on the Pyaar Ka Punchnama franchise.
The first season of the show was released on YouTube in June 2016, and the second season premiered on ZEE5 in April 2018.
plot: Life Sahi Hai is a sitcom revolving around four men, who have moved to Delhi with the intention to live independently for the first time, and the trouble they encounter in pursuing this goal. Throughout the series, the main characters retain positive attitudes toward their situation, as exemplified by the statement 'Life Sahi Hai'.

title: Lajwanti
summary:
Lajwanti is an Indian television drama show, which premiered on 28 September 2015 on Zee TV. The story is loosely based on Rajinder Singh Bedi's 1956 book titled Lajwanti, Land of five rivers and is set during Partition of India. The show was produced by Trilogy Media.
The show is about the relationship between Sunderlal Bharadwaj and Lajwanti (Lajo) living in Badami Bagh Lahore. Sunderlal first time meet on well when he went to Rohranwala Village to attend Marriage Ceremony of  his friend Lalchand Baniya. They face many perils throughout the course of their relationship. The series ended on 5 February 2016, where Sunder, who had previously lost his memory and wandered away, reunites with Lajo, and is stopped from marrying Gunwanti. Lajo and Sunder proceed to get married again, jubilantly ending the show.

title: Lakshmi Vandhachu
summary:
Lakshmi Vanthachu (Tamil: லட்சுமி வந்தாச்சு; transl. Lakshmi has come) is a 2015 Indian Tamil-language soap opera that aired on Zee Tamil and it stars Vani Bhojan. The show launched on 2 February 2015, and it aired Monday through Friday at 9:30PM (IST). On 19 June 2017, the show's timeslot moved to 6:30PM IST. The show ended with 720 episodes on 24 November 2017.
The show stars Vani Bhojan, Saran Rajesh, Mohana, Haripriya Isai, and Sulakshana. It was directed by Suresh Krissna and V. Sathasivam.
plot: Vetrivel, who lives in Pollachi, falls in love with Lakshimi. Lakshimi too loves him. Vetri is from a rich family, but has a bad past. 21 years earlier, his sister killed herself before his family members which confined his mother to a wheelchair and made her unable to speak, walk, or hear. His father, the Nattamai of their village, quits his job to look after his mother. He also has one elder brother who is still unmarried and two younger brothers where one is sent out of their house by his father as he was the main reason for his sister's suicide attempt. On the other hand, Lakshimi is a milk vendor who has three sisters and a mother. She is the only person who works hard for the family. At last, Vetri and Lakshimi decide to marry. On their wedding day, due to her mother's order, Lakshimi cannot come to the temple. After waiting for a long time for Lakshimi, Vetri decides to kill himself as he cannot fetch a bad name to his family, who are eagerly waiting for the arrival of their new daughter in law. Meanwhile, in Chennai, Nandhini, a happy go lucky person, falls in love with Shakthi. Shakthi also loves her. They decide to marry. But Nandhini's greedy caretakers (her father's brother and his wife) fix her marriage with a rich guy for money. Nadhini decides to elope with Shakthi. She escapes from the marriage hall and waits for Shakthi. Shakthi comes there and slaps Nandhini saying bad things about her character and just now he discovers all of Nanhini's flaws. Actually this is done by Anushka, Shakthi's houseowner's daughter, who also loves Shakthi and wants to separate him from Nandhini. Shakthi leaves Nandhini and goes by car. Depressed, Nandhini catches a bus and travels in that bus till its last stop. The bus is to Pollachi. She deboards at Pollachi. After thinking about Shakthi, she decides to commit suicide and goes to the top of a hill. There she meets Vetri who tries to kill himself. She stops him. Both of them narrates their tragic past to each other. After that Nandhini agrees to act like Lakshmi and goes with Vetri to his house. She wins the entire family's hearts.

title: Laut Aao Trisha
summary: Laut Aao Trisha is an Indian serial on Life OK, based on the Chilean telenovela ¿Dónde está Elisa? produced by TVN, which has had many other international adaptations. It was first about an 18-year-old girl Trisha, who goes missing after a beach party with friends, and how her mother struggles to get her back. But later after a format change the serial revolves around several other criminal cases who Advocate VK along with his secretary Trisha solves.

title: Lakshmi Baramma
summary: Lakshmi Baramma is a Kannada serial that aired on Colors Kannada. It premiered on 4 March 2013 and is the second longest running Kannada TV series. The second season of the series, Lakshmi Baramma 2 aired from 13 March 2023. It starred Tanvi Rao, Shamanth Gowda, Bhumika Ramesh.
plot:
Laxmi is an innocent village girl. She was an orphan and was raised by her grandmother. She had an evil step mother and her two sons. However, she had a good bonding with Nanjundi, her youngest stepbrother.
After marrying Chandan realises that her husband was in love with his girlfriend Shruthi. She wishes not to be an obstacle in his path and runs away from him. But the situation lands her to the house of Shruthi. On the other hand, Shruthi unknowing the truth about Laxmi accepts her as her younger sister and names her Chinnu much against the wishes of her mother.
The twist in the tale arrives when Shruthi is Chandan's girlfriend and their marriage fixed. Knowing this truth she consoles herself and decides to look into the marriage arrangements. At this time her marriage truth is discovered by Parvathi, her mother-in-law. Ranjith his uncle also aware of this truth. Kumudha, Chandan's evil aunt along with her secret husband Manoj tries to acquire the whole property in her name. The family is unaware of her evil plans. Kailash, Shruthi's father discovers Kumudha's truth but he was beaten to death by her husband. He was timely saved by Laxmi. Kumudha who is furious at Laxmi is furious and learns of her marriage secret. Now she plays a mind game with her. Kailash slowly recovers and then he warns Kumudha. Later even he gets to know the truth of Laxmi. Parvathi and Kailash decide to tell this truth to Shruthi and finally, everybody knows the truth.
Shruthi's mother Kalpana develops hatred against her. Using this Kumudha plays mind games with the family. Finally, Kumudha is exposed by Kailash, Ranjith and Laxmi. In the meantime Shruthi was pregnant. Her child is believed to be dead. Later they get another baby through in vitro fertilization (IVF) process and Laxmi becomes the surrogate mother. Later the earlier baby which was presumed to be dead was alive and it was captured and raised by Kumudha. After much hardship, the elder baby is back with the family and it was named Siri. The second child with Laxmi as a surrogate mother was named Adhya.
At this time a new character enters the lives of this joint family named Aniruddh. He gains the trust of the family and later he kidnaps Shruthi and makes her forget her past and convinces her that she is Shravya. On the other hand, the family believes Shruthi has died. Laxmi discovers Shruthi is alive and she is now identified as Shravya. She is not believed and she leaves the house to return with her sister.
Chandu's family disguises themselves as the Chakravarthi family, a wealthy business family from London and enter Bhargavi Devi's house. Ramachandra Rayaru disguises as Vasanth Chakravarthy, the eldest member of the family, his wife Sulochana as Shalini Chakravarthi, their daughter Kalpana as Sumalatha Chakravarthi and her husband Kailash as Amarnath Chakravarthi (S/O Shalini and Vasanth Chakravarthi). Ramu disguises as Sudeep Chakravarthi (S/O Sumalatha and Amarnath) and Chandu as car driver, Yuvraj Singh, Shveta as Sushma - daughter of Shalini and Vasanth. Ranjith disguises as Shvetananda Swamiji. The rest of the plot revolves around how Laxmi, Chandan along with the family bringing Shruthi back into their lives and remind her of the past.

articleSections.text: The serials Kulavadhu and Lakshmi Baramma were interconnected for months together in the quest to find the missing daughter of the character Gombe. The girl who was missing was being taken care of by the family in Kulavadhu serial and finally, the important characters from both serials come together for a while till the missing girl's episode gets over.

Kailash, Shruthi's father discovers Kumudha's truth but he was beaten to death by her husband. He was timely saved by Laxmi. Kumudha who is furious at Laxmi is furious and learns of her marriage secret. Now she plays a mind game with her. Kailash slowly recovers and then he warns Kumudha. Later even he gets to know the truth of Laxmi. Parvathi and Kailash decide to tell this truth to Shruthi and finally, everybody knows the truth.
Shruthi's mother Kalpana develops hatred against her. Using this Kumudha plays mind games with the family. Finally, Kumudha is exposed by Kailash, Ranjith and Laxmi. In the meantime Shruthi was pregnant. Her child is believed to be dead. Later they get another baby through in vitro fertilization (IVF) process and Laxmi becomes the surrogate mother. Later the earlier baby which was presumed to be dead was alive and it was captured and raised by Kumudha. After much hardship, the elder baby is back with the family and it was named Siri. The second child with Laxmi as a surrogate mother was named Adhya.
At this time a new character enters the lives of this joint family named Aniruddh. He gains the trust of the family and later he kidnaps Shruthi and makes her forget her past and convinces her that she is Shravya. On the other hand, the family believes Shruthi has died. Laxmi discovers Shruthi is alive and she is now identified as Shravya. She is not believed and she leaves the house to return with her sister.
Chandu's family disguises themselves as the Chakravarthi family, a wealthy business family from London and enter Bhargavi Devi's house. Ramachandra Rayaru disguises as Vasanth Chakravarthy, the eldest member of the family, his wife Sulochana as Shalini Chakravarthi, their daughter Kalpana as Sumalatha Chakravarthi and her husband Kailash as Amarnath Chakravarthi (S/O Shalini and Vasanth Chakravarthi). Ramu disguises as Sudeep Chakravarthi (S/O Sumalatha and Amarnath) and Chandu as car driver, Yuvraj Singh, Shveta as Sushma - daughter of Shalini and Vasanth. Ranjith disguises as Shvetananda Swamiji. The rest of the plot revolves around how Laxmi, Chandan along with the family bringing Shruthi back into their lives and remind her of the past.

title: Love Marriage Ya Arranged Marriage
summary: Love Marriage Ya Arranged Marriage (transl. Love Marriage or arranged Marriage) is an Indian soap opera that airs on Sony TV from 6 August 2012 and stars Rishika Mihani and Samaira Rao, Himanshu Malhotra and Ashish Kapoor. The show is set in Udaipur, Rajasthan.
plot:
The story starts with the two friends Shivani and Mansi. Mansi stays with her parents, elder brother (Kunal) and younger sister while Shivani stays with her parents. Shivani has an elder sister, Devyani, who is married to a businessman. Their marriage was arranged but is not a happy one as Devyani's husband does not like her penning up poems. Kunal is married to his heartthrob, Naina.
Shivani runs a shop named "Shagun Shaadi Ka" with the help of dwarfs — Karan and Arjun. The shop sells and caters everything related to weddings. Shivani and Mansi are the best of friends since childhood even after having small quarrels. However, the biggest one was when Devyani leaves her husband and comes to stay with her family in Udaipur from Kankroli. Mansi says that some arranged marriages may not be happy as the couple may have problems. Shivani says that her sister can never ever have a problem and leaves. Shivani plans to leave the city and shift elsewhere to save her from offensive sayings from neighbours and as she has no one left in the city. Shivani leaves a note for Mansi as she is unaware of this. Mansi learns that Shivani has sold her shop and has moved elsewhere and unable to find a note she thinks that she left for her.
The story takes a three-year leap after which Mansi's marriage has been fixed with a kind-hearted and similar kind of man like her: Anup Sisodiya. Anup's younger brother Sahil is in love with a girl and that girl is perhaps Shivani. Mansi and Shivani remain unaware of the fact. However, Shivani tries to meet Mansi again, when she comes to meet Sahil in Udaipur but in vain. Anup and Mansi's marriage happens whereas Sahil and Shivani have a registered marriage. Shivani and Mansi become aware of the fact that they are daughters-in-law of the same house. Sahil's mother Rajlaxmi doesn't accept Sahil's marriage, so Sahil marries Shivani again, in front of his family. Shivani and Mansi solve every problem in their marriage. Sahil's mother also accepts Shivani and after coming to know about her pregnancy. Shivani and Mansi fix their mother-in-law's and Anup's relationship. Anup and mansi develop feelings for each other but they are unaware of each other's feelings. Anup's mother plans to send them on a honeymoon, but they have to cancel the idea because of business issues. Mansi starts to think that Anup still has feelings for his ex-girlfriend. Mansi eventually leaves Anup and goes back to her house. Eventually, this misunderstanding is cleared and both Mansi and Anup confess their feelings for each other. The show ends on a happy note.

title: Looteri Dulhan
summary: Looteri Dulhan (transl. The plunder bride) is a Hindi television serial. That premiered on ImagineTV on 28 March 2011 and concluded on 11 August 2011. The show is inspired by real happenings of groom duping incidents based on Rajasthan and Haryana.
plot:
Looteri Dulhen is the story of Billo, a girl adopted by a Haryanvi family, who position themselves as sari traders from Uttar Pradesh. Their real business is to con 70-plus men who want to marry young woman and then flee with their valuables.
The show is loosely based on true incidents. Billo from UP, along with her family runs a business of robbing people by falsely marrying them and then fleeing with valuables soon after the wedding. The family otherwise owns a saree shop and their neighbours think that is how they make a living. Billo has been raised and trained by this family only for the con business. Billo was separated from her parents when she was very young, owing to severe flooding in their village. Each time that Billo marries a new ‘target’, she hopes she will somehow, amongst the guests and families, find her real family again.
At another such wedding, Billo meets her real father, and he happens to do her kanyadan. Billo decides that since her real father has given her away in marriage, this is a sacred relation for her. She will not cheat this man; this is the one that she will settle down with. She tells her husband Abhinav her true identity but, this time, the game is on her. Abhinav is already married, with a terminally sick wife, for whose treatment he now requires Billo to keep working as Looteri Dulhan.
They loot a new victim and flee with Suman to another city for her treatment, because the police was after them. This was something Suman wasn't aware of because she gets more ill; they did all that in an emergency. Suman couldn't survive. When she had some days left, she said that her last wish would be that she could return home to her in-laws.
Abhinav belonged to a rich family with a grandfather, grandmother, his father, his mother, his uncle, uncle's wife, his younger uncle and his wife, his two younger sisters and younger brother. But his father didn't accept Summan as his daughter-in-law. Because of that, he suspected that her father who was their cleaner was a thief which wasn't true.
Because of the family, Suman came home at the last moment she was alive. She got ill there and they went to her room. The last thing she said to Abhinav was that he would promise her to accept Billo as her wife after she died. Everyone in the family thought that Billo was Suman's sister.
After a time Abhinav's brother came back home after being out of the house for a while. He fell in love with Billo and so did Abhinav.

articleSections.title: Launched
articleSections.text: The series, with a budget of about ₹1.5 crores, from its launch had a low viewership. Due to the less viewership causing losses, it went on a revamp in June 2011 with exit of the entire cast except the leads Supriya Kumari and Mrunal Jain and addition with a new cast of 17 members with cost efficient actors. However this also did not work for them and the series was cancelled in August 2011.

title: Love U Zindagi
summary: Love U Zindagi - Geet Ke Funde is an Indian television series which premiered on 29 January 2011 on STAR Plus. The series is based on the story of Rahul, a broken hearted scion of an industrialist family and Geet, a young, bold and bubbly girl. The story is set in a Punjabi backdrop, and is loosely based on the Shahid Kapoor and Kareena Kapoor starrer Jab We Met.

articleSections.title: About the show
articleSections.text: The show is the about the romance of two individuals who are complete opposites. Rahul is a broken hearted scion of an industrialist family who is escaping from life itself. Geet is a Sikhni from Bhatinda with a zest for life, and who lives for the moment. The young couple meet each other on the Punjab Mail train and begin the memorable journey of their lives first from Bombay, to Bhatinda, then to Manali.

title: Laagi Tujhse Lagan
summary:
Laagi Tujhse Lagan (transl. Determined to Love You) is an Indian television series that aired Monday to Thursday on Colors TV from 28 December 2009 to 6 January 2012.
Set in rural Maharashtra, it is the love story of Nakusha portrayed by Mahii Vij, a beautiful young woman who is forced to hide her beauty, and Dutta Bhau portrayed by Mishal Raheja (later by Shabbir Ahluwalia) who is a local gangster.
plot:
Nakusha is a young woman who lives with her mother Badi, father Ganpat, and brother Sethji. As her elder sister was given undue advantage of due to her fairness, Nakusha blackens herself to appear less attractive. A corrupt police officer, Malmal More, discovers her secret and arranges their engagement. However, Babi uncovers More’s plan to sell Nakusha in Dubai and helps her escape, where she meets Dutta Bhau, a gangster, who saves Nakusha's life but is badly injured. Grateful, Nakusha helps him recover, and Dutta brings Nakusha and her family to live with him as domestic workers. Dutta’s three sisters, Kala, Leela, and Roops, secretly covet his wealth and pretend to care for him, while his childhood friend Bajirao remains loyal.
Unafraid of Dutta, Nakusha encourages him to quit drinking. When Dutta's mother tries to convince him to marry a girl named Supriya, Dutta hesitates and reveals to Nakusha about his failed relationship with a woman, Seema, who left him for a richer man, before becoming a gangster. Nakusha encourages Dutta to give Supriya a chance and their wedding is fixed. However, Supriya is in love with another man, Ravi, and Kala manipulates the situation, leading to Supriya eloping on her wedding day. Dutta, believing Nakusha helped her escape, angrily marries Nakusha in retaliation.
Dutta and Nakusha start an uneasy marriage with Dutta mistreating her. When Dutta finally discovers her innocence, he asks her to leave him. However, Dutta and Nakusha are soon lost in a jungle when goons of Dutta's enemy, Anna attack them. There, they meet Jagtap Dada who makes Dutta realize Nakusha's worth before he dies saving them. Nakusha is abducted by Anna. Dutta kills Anna and, now in love with her, brings Nakusha home. Kala and her sisters fail to separate them. Dutta learns about his father, Damodar Patil and his half-sister, Madhu. Damodar soon dies due to cancer.
The family decides to arrange a wedding ceremony for Dutta and Nakusha. On the wedding night, Dutta discovers Nakusha’s true fair complexion, which angers him, but Nakusha’s unwavering love wins him over. A rival of Dutta, Chaskar, causes his accident. Dutta survives but becomes blind and encounters Seema. Nakusha's search leads her to Dutta, and they end up in a village, where Dutta has his eyesight cured and Chaskar is killed. Kala is then exposed before Dutta, and she kidnaps his family, while Leela's husband, Sudarshan, joins Kala. Dutta saves the whole family, forgives Sudarshan, and kicks out Kala. Leela and Roops, fed up with Kala's plans, pledge allegiance to their brother. Dutta and Nakusha return home, and Dutta's mentor, Nana Saheb, comes to live with them.
While praying at a temple, Dutta is abducted, and Nakusha disappears. Bajirao is accused of the crime and is thrown out of the house by Dutta's mother. When it is revealed that Bajirao is innocent and Nana Saheb is the culprit, Dutta's family is forced to leave their home. Meanwhile, Nakusha is given shelter by a woman in a fishery village. However, she remembers nothing from her past life and is named Sahiba. She then meets Dighu, who falls in love with her. Eventually, Dutta, who is held hostage by Nana, escapes, and it is revealed that Nana and Kala had been working together. Dighu, unaware of this, brings Nakusha to Nana's house. Dighu helps Baji and the family by returning them to their home that was under Nana's hands. He then discovers that Nana is guilty of his mother's death and kills him. Dutta then discovers that Dighu is the one who kidnapped him and punishes him. Nakusha, now pregnant, leaves the house, not wanting her child to be raised in a gangster's home. Dutta follows her and begins to change his life. Yoginder shoots Dutta's mother as Sudarshan watches. Nakusha is kidnapped by Yoginder, who is eventually killed along with his sister Sunaina and Dighu. The show concludes with Dutta and Nakusha reuniting.
reception:
Ratings
Laagi Tujhse Lagan was one of the most watched Hindi GEC. The show was its peak from the beginning till the end of March 2011.
In week of 26 March 2011, it occupied second position with 5.6 TVR.
After the exit of lead actor Mishal Raheja in last week of March 2011, the show TRP rating started to go down and eventually ended in January 2012.

As her elder sister was given undue advantage of due to her fairness, Nakusha blackens herself to appear less attractive. A corrupt police officer, Malmal More, discovers her secret and arranges their engagement. However, Babi uncovers More’s plan to sell Nakusha in Dubai and helps her escape, where she meets Dutta Bhau, a gangster, who saves Nakusha's life but is badly injured. Grateful, Nakusha helps him recover, and Dutta brings Nakusha and her family to live with him as domestic workers. Dutta’s three sisters, Kala, Leela, and Roops, secretly covet his wealth and pretend to care for him, while his childhood friend Bajirao remains loyal.
Unafraid of Dutta, Nakusha encourages him to quit drinking. When Dutta's mother tries to convince him to marry a girl named Supriya, Dutta hesitates and reveals to Nakusha about his failed relationship with a woman, Seema, who left him for a richer man, before becoming a gangster. Nakusha encourages Dutta to give Supriya a chance and their wedding is fixed. However, Supriya is in love with another man, Ravi, and Kala manipulates the situation, leading to Supriya eloping on her wedding day. Dutta, believing Nakusha helped her escape, angrily marries Nakusha in retaliation.
Dutta and Nakusha start an uneasy marriage with Dutta mistreating her. When Dutta finally discovers her innocence, he asks her to leave him. However, Dutta and Nakusha are soon lost in a jungle when goons of Dutta's enemy, Anna attack them. There, they meet Jagtap Dada who makes Dutta realize Nakusha's worth before he dies saving them. Nakusha is abducted by Anna. Dutta kills Anna and, now in love with her, brings Nakusha home. Kala and her sisters fail to separate them. Dutta learns about his father, Damodar Patil and his half-sister, Madhu. Damodar soon dies due to cancer.
The family decides to arrange a wedding ceremony for Dutta and Nakusha. On the wedding night, Dutta discovers Nakusha’s true fair complexion, which angers him, but Nakusha’s unwavering love wins him over. A rival of Dutta, Chaskar, causes his accident. Dutta survives but becomes blind and encounters Seema. Nakusha's search leads her to Dutta, and they end up in a village, where Dutta has his eyesight cured and Chaskar is killed. Kala is then exposed before Dutta, and she kidnaps his family, while Leela's husband, Sudarshan, joins Kala. Dutta saves the whole family, forgives Sudarshan, and kicks out Kala. Leela and Roops, fed up with Kala's plans, pledge allegiance to their brother. Dutta and Nakusha return home, and Dutta's mentor, Nana Saheb, comes to live with them.
While praying at a temple, Dutta is abducted, and Nakusha disappears. Bajirao is accused of the crime and is thrown out of the house by Dutta's mother. When it is revealed that Bajirao is innocent and Nana Saheb is the culprit, Dutta's family is forced to leave their home. Meanwhile, Nakusha is given shelter by a woman in a fishery village. However, she remembers nothing from her past life and is named Sahiba. She then meets Dighu, who falls in love with her. Eventually, Dutta, who is held hostage by Nana, escapes, and it is revealed that Nana and Kala had been working together. Dighu, unaware of this, brings Nakusha to Nana's house. Dighu helps Baji and the family by returning them to their home that was under Nana's hands. He then discovers that Nana is guilty of his mother's death and kills him. Dutta then discovers that Dighu is the one who kidnapped him and punishes him. Nakusha, now pregnant, leaves the house, not wanting her child to be raised in a gangster's home. Dutta follows her and begins to change his life. Yoginder shoots Dutta's mother as Sudarshan watches. Nakusha is kidnapped by Yoginder, who is eventually killed along with his sister Sunaina and Dighu. The show concludes with Dutta and Nakusha reuniting.
tagline: Nakusha is a young woman who lives with her mother Badi, father Ganpat, and brother Sethji.

title: Lapataganj
summary:
Lapataganj – Sharad Joshi Ki Kahaniyon Ka Pata is an Indian television sitcom, aired on Sony SAB from October 2009 to 15 August 2014. The series is based on Sharad Joshi’s novel of the same name.
The show was produced by Ashwini Dheer and directed by Dharam Verma. Joshi's daughter Neha Sharad was the creative head of the show for the first six months.
Lapatagnj starred Rohitash Gaud, Vineet Kumar, Preeti Amin, Sucheta, Shubhangi Gokhale, and the first episode aired on  26 October 2009.
plot:
Based in an imaginary small town called Lapataganj (meaning a lost place), the story is inspired by the writings of Sharad Joshi, who was a Hindi satirist. His wide range of works has highlighted the bitter truth of Indian society with a satirical punch. These stories, while making viewers laugh, also make them empathise with the situations people face in their daily lives.
Lapataganj is a town in some part of India which has been long forgotten by the system. The town struggles daily for basic facilities, yet the people residing there are the happiest of the lot. The show captures the spirit of the common man to lead a happy life against all odds.

articleSections.title: Awards
articleSections.text: The show and its actors won awards during its run time - including Indian Telly Awards, Indian Television Academy Awards, Zee Gold Awards.

episodesList.title: Water Crisis
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and other villagers are tensed as there is again no water supply. The man who has come to see Sureeli for marriage, rejects her because she is dumb.

episodesList.title: Pappu Sneaks Into Sureeli's Room
episodesList.summary: Mukundi starts his day with a fight with Indumati which spoils his mood. Pappu sneaks into Sureeli's room and starts flirting with her.

episodesList.title: The Election Day
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Lapataganj is busy discussing the upcoming elections in the village. There arises a debate over whether or not the women in the village should cast a vote or not.

episodesList.title: Guddu to Write a Love Letter
episodesList.summary: Pappu tells Guddu that he is scared of expressing his love for Sureeli. He decides to pen down his feelings in a letter. He goes around the village asking for a pen and paper.

episodesList.title: Movie Buffs
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are extremely happy to see that there is a new movie to watch. Indu insists Mukundi takes her to watch the movie whereas Pappu tries his best to take Sureeli for the movie.

episodesList.title: The Theatre Shuts Down
episodesList.summary: The local theatre is overcrowded as everyone is too excited to watch the movie which is currently being shown. The theatre manager is devastated after the district collector gives an order to shut down the theatre permanently.

episodesList.title: Malan Devi's Surrender
episodesList.summary: There are announcements made in the village about Malan Devi surrendering herself near the lake. Indu shows a lot of interest in this and asks Mukundi hundreds of questions regarding the same.

episodesList.title: Indu's Wish to See a Dacoit
episodesList.summary: Most of the people in the village travel to watch Malan Devi's surrender. Indu wakes Mukundi up from his sleep, asking him to take her to watch the surrender. Mukundi ends up giving in when he learns that the entire village is going.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Becomes a Scape Goat
episodesList.summary: Seeing Indu trade chocolate to get her work done from their son, Mukundi opposes her act. Mukundi gets stuck between his two bosses as they mistreat him for disrespecting them.

episodesList.title: Neta Pandey's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Neta Pandey is disturbed after seeing a letter missing from his name outside his house. He begins to look for the person who is responsible for meddling with his name.

episodesList.title: Santosh is In Town
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Kachua are excited to meet Mukundi's brother, Santosh. Mishri makes Sureeli get ready and takes her to meet Santosh with an objective to get them hitched.

episodesList.title: Santosh Flirts With Laali
episodesList.summary: Santosh tries to woo Laali but Mishri takes her to her house just in time. Indu is surprised to see Santosh suddenly showing interest in marriage. He tries impressing Laali all day.

episodesList.title: Finding a Colossus
episodesList.summary: Seeing problems increase at a high rate in Lapataganj, Baba says that only a colossus can save the village. All the villagers start looking for one for the upliftment of Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Growing Adulteration
episodesList.summary: Indu yells at the milkman for giving her diluted milk and warns him one last time. Other people in the village notice adulteration in certain food items being sold in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Protests Against Adulteration
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is forced to observe a fast to protest against growing adulteration in the village. The people in Lapataganj aim towards making the local minister take an action against the same.

episodesList.title: Mukundi to Take a Casual Leave
episodesList.summary: As Mukundi is lost in deep thoughts, people around him mistake him for having a toothache. Mukundi is in reality thinking whether he should take a casual leave from work or not.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Gets Threatened
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is kicked out of the ration shop when he asks for sugar. He is also threatened to not open his mouth, otherwise he will be beaten up.

episodesList.title: The Ashamed Minister
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Lapataganj wonders why the minister is ashamed. Indu insists Mukundi takes her to see the ashamed minister. Many people go to visit the minister to find out why he is ashamed.

episodesList.title: Destruction Due to Worms
episodesList.summary: Indu gives Mukundi a task to keep the wheat out for drying as it is attacked by worms. Mishri assigns Kachua a similar task as a few of their food items have caught fungus.

episodesList.title: Struggle to Pass Higher Secondary
episodesList.summary: Indu's uncle is in power and offers to help Chukundi. Pappu tries to impress Indu in order to get his passing certificate through her uncle's source.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Gets an Award
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's honesty gets the rightful reward and is interviewed by the media. Lapataganj is in a mood to celebrate when this news spreads like haywire.

episodesList.title: Miseries Of Marriage
episodesList.summary: Indu and Mukundi are on different note about wedding expenses. Everyone is set for Poonam's marriage when the groom's family starts demanding more dowry.

episodesList.title: Intellectuals Come to Rescue
episodesList.summary: Kachua takes the Politician's speech too seriously. By calling himself an intellectual, he sets out to solve various problems of the residents.

episodesList.title: Mystery Of The Neem Tree
episodesList.summary: A film crew comes across Lapataganj for shooting and finds it ideal. The residents get busy to fill up the dried up lake but the heroine's whims and fancies are elsewhere.

episodesList.title: The Heroine's Demand
episodesList.summary: A film crew comes across Lapataganj for shooting and finds it ideal. The residents get busy to fill up the dried up lake but the heroine's whims and fancies are elsewhere.

episodesList.title: Chaubey From Lena Bank
episodesList.summary: A loan agent arrives at Lapataganj and targets Pappu. Pappu feels Mukundi is the perfect person for Chaubey to pursue and explains about the loan to the residents.

episodesList.title: Every Husband's Problem
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is irritated with Indu's questioning and decides to go to Asansol. The disagreement accelerates when the different residents give their opinions in this regard.

episodesList.title: Hanumanji's Arrival
episodesList.summary: The villagers have their own unique way of worshipping. Pappu and Indu fight over a newspaper that encloses a vacancy for the priest.

episodesList.title: Interview For Priest's Role
episodesList.summary: Pappu is depressed about his voice but with Hanuman's blessing, he recovers. Mukundi suggests to him how to apply for the role of the priest.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Transformation
episodesList.summary: The villagers are shocked to see Pappu's change and dedication towards his profession. Sureeli is heartbroken to know Pappu's decision but still pursues him.

episodesList.title: Vasanti Visits
episodesList.summary: Indu's sister, Vasanti, comes to Lapataganj to visit her. Mishri has lost her goat and files a report. Vasanti and Mukundi team up to preach the villagers about poetry.

episodesList.title: Kachua's Laziness
episodesList.summary: Kachua oversleeps amidst the rush in the morning, so Pappu pulls a prank on him. Mukundi reminds Kachua of all the things he has lost due to his laziness.

episodesList.title: Playboy Pappu
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Kachua go to the river to get water and Pappu uses this opportunity to spend time with Sureeli. Later on, Pappu gets lost in his thoughts of his previous lover.

episodesList.title: Sukumari is In Crisis
episodesList.summary: Pappu is collecting the donation from the villagers when he catches a glimpse of Sukumari. Sureeli starts doubting Pappu but he still sorts out Sukumari's problem.

episodesList.title: Combating Robbery
episodesList.summary: Kachua, Pappu, and Guddu stay at Mishri's place to catch the thieves. Once they catch the thieves, a much bigger problem arises at the police station.

episodesList.title: Mango Desire
episodesList.summary: At times, even the common man wishes to feel special. With a lot of hardship, Lapataganj indulges in cherishing the off-seasonal mango.

episodesList.title: The All Knowing Stranger
episodesList.summary: A stranger arrives at Lapataganj who recognises each and every member of the village. Was he previously a resident too?

episodesList.title: New Age Teacher
episodesList.summary: The old-school preaching needs dusting now, so Mukundi puts his effort to impart his son with few ethics. Mukundi stands against the wrong procedure used by the teachers of today and tries to bridge the gap.

episodesList.title: The Lost Party
episodesList.summary: Pappu is upset as his party has lost the elections. The villagers start debating over the pros and cons of the parties have and how could one win over another.

episodesList.title: New Year
episodesList.summary: In Lapataganj, the new year brings new hopes with water. Mishri's husband decides to return on this occasion and the villagers celebrate their new emerging sun.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj In Competition
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's poetic uncle arrives at Lapataganj and Chukundi is excited to receive gifts. Pappu along with the villagers bet over a kite flying competition.

episodesList.title: Advent Of Mama Ji
episodesList.summary: Ghasita Mamaji's mannerisms are quite unique. The villagers mistakenly perceive him as a stranger trying to steal or spoil their village culture which leads to an attack on him.

episodesList.title: American Guest
episodesList.summary: Indian culture works as an attraction for many tourists from across the world. A tourist from New York, Anuradha visits Lapataganj and the villagers are insane to meet her and know about America.

episodesList.title: Seeing Off The Guest
episodesList.summary: The villagers perform for Anuradha and Indu dresses her up as an Indian woman. Anuradha falls in love with the unity and close bond of Lapataganj. Anuradha and the villagers get upset on parting.

episodesList.title: Gandhijis Glasses
episodesList.summary: A controversy on Gandhiji's glasses getting stolen from the museum. Kachua gets suspected as his glasses have a similar circular frame.

episodesList.title: Coincidence or Politics
episodesList.summary: The residents of Lapataganj are infuriated about an outsider being their leader which leads to a fight. The villagers stand together against the false-telling politicians trying to influence them for mere votes.

episodesList.title: Sugandhilals Umbrella
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's father keeps his umbrella close to his heart. Suddenly, his umbrella gets misplaced. How will Sugandhi find his special umbrella?

episodesList.title: Victims Of Corruption
episodesList.summary: Sugandhi wants to build a school in his village premise and has to visit the government office for permission. Each time Mukundi visits, he has to suffer. Finally, the father-son realise that nothing runs without corruption.

episodesList.title: Shakkarkandi Against Corruption
episodesList.summary: Sugandhi shuts himself till his father is brought to Lapataganj. Pappu and Guddu bring Shakkarkandilal, Mukundi's grandfather. Mukundi with the help of the villagers takes revenge from Dubey.

episodesList.title: How to Pass The Time?
episodesList.summary: Kachua spends his time by small talking to different residents of Lapataganj. Pappu spends time by flirting with Sureeli and pulling pranks. A stranger fools the villagers to start digging their ground to find his ancestral treasure.

episodesList.title: Sugandhi Befriends a Crow
episodesList.summary: Sugandhi sings, feeds and talks to a crow in order to spend his free time. Kachua and Pappu pranks on him to have some fun. Sugandhi feels that his old acquaintance is now a crow.

episodesList.title: Sureeli's Seeker
episodesList.summary: Pappu's nightmare comes true as he sees an intruder, Chimpu with Sureeli. Chimpu organises a dance competition and asks Sureeli to participate, but the whole Lapataganj performs in the competition.

episodesList.title: Pappu Feels Repulsed
episodesList.summary: The competition gets even better when the villagers are engaged in street practice. Pappu removes the tyres of Chimpu's bike due to his insecurity. Sambha tries to hit on Pappu but he refrains.

episodesList.title: Dance Competition At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chimpu attempts to impress Mishri and Sureeli which Pappu revolts against. The villagers compete with one another to come to a conclusion.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj On Republic Day
episodesList.summary: Mukundi explains the meaning of constitution to Indu. The villagers perform on the theme of Republic Day and Sureeli emerges as the winner.

episodesList.title: The Smile Week
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's boss announces that they will be celebrating smile day in the upcoming week, where they have to talk to every client with a smile. Mukundi starts practicing for this right away.

episodesList.title: The Wishlist
episodesList.summary: Indu hands over Mukundi a long list of items she needs. When he tries to turn her wish down, she tells him that he never fulfills any of her wishes.

episodesList.title: The Crisis
episodesList.summary: Mishri chucks Pappu out of her house seeing him brush his teeth with Sureeli. Mishri and Indu discuss how there are various things in the village but are actually of no use.

episodesList.title: Winter Takes a Toll On Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: It is a relatively colder day in Lapataganj and everyone is shivering even after covered in layers. Chotu mama freezes after taking a shower from ice cold water.

episodesList.title: Pappu Hates Seeing Sureeli Work
episodesList.summary: Pappu feels bad for Sureeli seeing her sweep the floor and asks her to stop. Mishri assigns him the task of sweeping when she sees this. Pappu passes over the task to Guddu to avoid working.

episodesList.title: A Match Of Kabaddi
episodesList.summary: The men in Lapataganj play a match of Kabaddi against the men of Gumshudaganj, a neighbouring village. After a lot of running and injuries, watch which team wins the match.

episodesList.title: Pappu Gets Injured
episodesList.summary: The game of Kabaddi leaves Pappu seriously injured, leaving Sureeli extremely worried. Right when Sureeli is about to give Pappu a massage, Chotu mama stops her and starts massaging Pappu himself.

episodesList.title: Kabaddi Training
episodesList.summary: Pappu starts selecting eligible people to raise a Kabaddi team in Lapataganj which can compete against other strong teams. All the team members start training for Kabaddi.

episodesList.title: A Tough Game
episodesList.summary: As the Lapataganj team begins to play with their opposition which is the national team, their supporters begin to lose hope seeing them play. They try making a comeback but Guddu gets seriously injured.

episodesList.title: Being a Greater Person
episodesList.summary: The Lapataganj team loses the game on purpose as they did not want to defeat the national team as that would be a loss for them. The national kabaddi team asks people to support all sports along with cricket.

episodesList.title: Indu has a Crush
episodesList.summary: Indu cannot keep calm as her favorite actor, Ramesh Kumar's movie is being shown at the theatre. Mukundi is surprised seeing Indu go gaga over Ramesh Kumar as she sticks his posters in the house.

episodesList.title: Tips For Begging
episodesList.summary: A man asks people in Lapataganj to help him with some money as his wallet has been robbed. They give him tips to beg for money so that he can buy a ticket to his destination.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Sacred Of Going Bald
episodesList.summary: Mukundi gets worried when a few bald men from the village tell him that even he is getting bald. Mukundi sees a dream where he has lost all his hair and Indu is leaving him forever.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Gets a Golden Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Mukundi tells his friends that he has been chosen to deliver a speech on Gandhiji in Gujarat by the postal department. Even though Indu does not insist on taking her along, he wishes to take his family along with him.

episodesList.title: Growing Obsession For Movie
episodesList.summary: Pappu imagines himself nothing less than a hero. Mishri tells Indu that she is going for an English movie so Indu starts demanding Mukundi. Later on, the whole Lapataganj gets inside the movie hall.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj Day
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Lapataganj Day, the residents perform to celebrate. The politicians argue on land reform policy and plan to extort the residents of Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Silence is a Virtue
episodesList.summary: Pappu tries to influence Mukundi and Kachua but they, in turn, preach him about silence. Mishri fixed Sureeli's marriage to an influential person from a different village and Pappu goes silent.

episodesList.title: Holika At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chotu is against the kids playing with colours and Mukundi argues with Indu on the expenditure of Holi. The women prepare sweets and the village unites to burn the Holika.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Holi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is fooled by Indu into playing Holi and Chotu still complains about Chukundi hitting him with balloons. Pappu rushes to put colour on Sureeli when everyone else is inclined to celebrating.

episodesList.title: Controversary On Strike
episodesList.summary: Mukundi influences everyone to work more on the strike day. Everyone doubles up their prices for the sake of loss. Chukundi meets with an accident but there is no doctor to be found.

episodesList.title: The Quest For Well
episodesList.summary: The residents wait eternally in front of their village tap. The collector asks them to search for the well in their village. Police start investigating about the lost well.

episodesList.title: Budget Of The Year
episodesList.summary: The villagers worship the Finance Minister for a good budget outcome. Mukundi does a lot of shopping before the budget is released. When the politicians are plotting to increase the budget, the villagers try to keep their savings up.

episodesList.title: Buntys Friendship
episodesList.summary: Pappu's birthday is in a week and his friend from Delhi arrives at Lapataganj. Bunty tries to distance Pappu from his neighbours and also attempts to change his birthday plan. Will Pappu withstand this?

episodesList.title: Lapataganj Under Trial
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Kachua discuss India's pending development. Pappu catches a man stalking Sureeli and gives it right to him. The politician's maid revolts as she wants to join the party.

episodesList.title: Consistency Of Drought
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj is a drought prone area and the villagers want Mukundi to make the government aware of it. Indu and Mukundi have visitors from a flood prone area. Together, the villagers plot a drama to bring awareness.

episodesList.title: Politicians Amusement
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's letter was rejected so the politician is invited to Lapataganj. The villagers put across their issues to him but still, nothing is resolved.

episodesList.title: Dignified Chotu
episodesList.summary: Chotu finds a bag full of money but has to give it back to Police. Chotu is dignified by the politician for his deed. Pappu decides he also wants to feel respected and takes help from Bajrangbali.

episodesList.title: Media In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: The journalist enquires about the lost idol case. Police refuse to search the idol anymore. The villagers get busy to find the idol all over the area but Chotu takes away the credit.

episodesList.title: Counting The Stars
episodesList.summary: Pappu makes notes for Sureeli to help her pass the exam. Mukundi borrows a phone to have a word with Indu. Pappu imagines him and Sureeli as Mukundi and Indu.

episodesList.title: A Dog's Day
episodesList.summary: Chotu strikes at a dog mistakenly and injures it. Police arrest him for committing the crime and the Dog Minister takes over the case.

episodesList.title: The Suspicious Sneeze
episodesList.summary: The villagers misjudge Chotu's sneeze as something dangerous to their health. What is the reason behind Chotu's sneeze? Is it a box full of spices or a life-threatening disease?

episodesList.title: The Art Of Bribery
episodesList.summary: Mukundi complaints about a politician trying to bribe him. Once the media covers the incident, the party members decide to take a firm step ahead.

episodesList.title: Elizabeth's New Avatar
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj's residents complain about their still old fashioned ways. Elizabeth's evolution makes them amazingly shocked right at his entry.

episodesList.title: Friends Turned Into Enemies
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Guddu are in bad terms and fight it out. Lapataganj gets divided into two due to their differences. Mukundi is stuck in between them.

episodesList.title: Memories Of Indu
episodesList.summary: The villagers are ecstatic to see Indu back in Lapataganj. Mukundi is lost in Indu's thoughts, so the villagers plan to dress up Guddu like her.

episodesList.title: Moneyplant and Cactus
episodesList.summary: The village kids are playing in the ground and Mamaji gets hit on his head. Pappu and his friends start making fun of him. He also tells that he would have been very happy if Mamaji got injured badly and would celebrate by distributing sweets all over Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Gods Miracle
episodesList.summary: Chotu makes his bed and is ready to sleep. Mishri gets him milk, but then two orphaned kids come and ask for food. When Chotu does not give them his milk, they curse him. Later in the night, someone calls Mishri and she is shocked to witness it.

episodesList.title: Reporters In Hanumanganj
episodesList.summary: People go crazy as they witness Hanuman Ji drinking milk. Everybody comes in Hanumanganj and start worshipping him. Reporters come as they want to cover this astonishing story.

episodesList.title: Amitabh In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Amitabh enters Lapatanganj and all the villagers go crazy. Everyone gathers around him and holds him tightly so that he is unable to leave. Sureeli is a big fan and tries to shower her love for him.

episodesList.title: Mastaana Band In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mastana Band artists are in Lapataganj in hope that they will get some customers. They play and entertain Pappu who keeps on telling them how bad they are as musicians. Later, they go on a hunt to find customers who want to get married.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Dream
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Gattu are coming back riding on the bicycle. But Pappu has a dream of owning a motorcycle and how he would impress everyone in Lapataganj. He starts dreaming of how famous he will be if he gets a motorcycle.

episodesList.title: Trouble On Everyone
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Gattu find a visitor who falls on the ground suddenly. They tell everyone about this and everyone gets scared how to hide this body. Mukundi gets scared when he sees his father coming back.

episodesList.title: Police Interrupts The Plan
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Lapataganj makes a plan to remove the body from their area. So they take him out of Lapataganj in a procession. But then suddenly, police enters Lapataganj. Will the police find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Kachua is Back
episodesList.summary: Kachus is back in Lapataganj from his trip. Everyone in the area gets excited and gather around him. Mukundi asks Kachua about his journey and gets to know that Kachua had been to jail as well.

episodesList.title: Kachuas Truth
episodesList.summary: Kachua gets beaten by the opposition party. Mishri and Elija put ointment and asks Kachua to take rest. Mishri asks him what did he say such things that he got beaten so badly.

episodesList.title: Vimla's Ghost
episodesList.summary: Mishri comes to a peepal tree to offer sweets to Vimla on her death anniversary. As soon as Mishri leaves, the sweets disappear. A few people in the neighborhood feel the presence of a ghost around them.

episodesList.title: Exorcism Of Chotu Mama
episodesList.summary: Vimla's ghost continues to haunt the entire village. Everyone is scared of Chotu mama as he starts speaking and acting like late Vimla. Chotu is made to sit through an exorcism by an exorcist.

episodesList.title: Disturbed Chotu
episodesList.summary: Mishri and other villagers are worried seeing Chotu collapsed in the middle of the road. The entire day he acts really strange after seeing Vimla with a lantern in her hand, the previous day.

episodesList.title: Kachua Feels Lonely
episodesList.summary: After getting ready in the morning, Kachua leaves for a walk in the village but feels ignored by the people. Due to loneliness, Kachua decides to get married leaving the villagers surprised.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Indu starts crying when Mukundi says no to her plea for taking her for a vacation. Mukundi tries to show Indu that he would be in debt if he takes her out, but his plan backfires on him.

episodesList.title: Unwanted Guests
episodesList.summary: Indu cannot keep calm seeing her mother, sister, and brother-in-law, who have come to pay her a surprise visit. Mukundi does not seem pleased seeing guests arrive in his house without any prior notice.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Loses His Calm
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is already sick of the guests, as they are causing him trouble every minute of the day. He later loses his calm when he finds out that his brother-in-law has been taking debt in his name.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Disguises As His Father
episodesList.summary: Mukundi looks for ideas to kick the guests out of his house as they won't leave. Mukundi disguises himself as his father because Indu's mother hates him. He is shocked to see his father in front of him when he is dressed up as him.

episodesList.title: Chukundi Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: While leaving for work, Mukundi falls into a manhole and hurts himself. He fights with the contractor for digging a manhole which might be dangerous for pedestrians. In the evening, Mukundi and Indu are extremely worried as Chukundi goes missing.

episodesList.title: Chukundi Falls Into a Manhole
episodesList.summary: Mukundi goes crazy after hearing Chukundi talk from inside a big manhole. This becomes a matter of concern and as the media comes to cover the incident. After a lot of chaos, Chukundi is taken out of the manhole.

episodesList.title: Fake Currency
episodesList.summary: A fake note owned by Mukundi is circulated around the village before it reaches a policeman. Mukundi gets caught for producing fake currency but the real culprit is somebody else.

episodesList.title: Mukundi to Get Fired
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Indu get into an argument over who does more work throughout the day. After talking to his boss, Mukundi predicts that he is going to be fired soon. He decides to hide this news from his wife.

episodesList.title: A Surprise For Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is frightened after hearing people's stories after they have got fired from their jobs. He is relieved to find out that they have received a new consignment.

episodesList.title: The Pickle Story
episodesList.summary: Mukundi craves for some pickle but is upset to find out that all the pickle in his house is over. Indu, with the help of Mishri, begins to prepare pickle and decides to surprise Mukundi.

episodesList.title: Blood Donation
episodesList.summary: A blood donation camp is set in Lapataganj which excites all the villagers. Indu is adamant about donating blood even though Mukundi is against it.

episodesList.title: Sureeli to Marry a Dog
episodesList.summary: Mishri gets convinced to get Sureeli married to a dog, which according to the priest will clear the fault in her stars. Sureeli cries her eyes out when she finds out that she is going to get married to a dog.

episodesList.title: Pappu Accepts a Challenge
episodesList.summary: Pappu picks up the dog Sureeli is getting married to, and once again asks Mishri if he can marry Sureeli. Pappu accepts the challenge of earning five thousand rupees in a week to get married to Sureeli.

episodesList.title: Pappu Goes to Extremes
episodesList.summary: A reward of five thousand rupees is announced to whoever rides a bicycle for five days straight. Pappu takes up the challenge to fulfill Mishri's condition for getting Sureeli married to Pappu.
